Operation_Name_English: Early vocational and occupational rehabilitation model in the return-to-work process from a health perspective
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Model zgodnje poklicne in zaposlitvene rehabilitacije v procesu vračanja na delo z vidika zdravja
Category_Label: Measures to improve the accessibility, effectiveness and resilience of healthcare systems (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to establish a model of integrated early vocational and employment rehabilitation for persons with mental health problems, which will enable faster and more successful return to work, and consequently (wider effects) reduce the duration of sick leave and disability retirements, or will contribute to increasing the preservation of employment and social inclusion of that group of persons. The purpose of the project is also to assess the performance of the model tested in the project and to support the introduction of the necessary systemic changes for the implementation of comprehensive early vocational and employment rehabilitation in Slovenia. The objectives of the project are: 1. Preparation of expert bases for comprehensive treatment of persons with mental health problems by adapting the model of integrated early vocational and employment rehabilitation in the process of returning to work. 2. Raising awareness and information of users of health services, employers, the professional public and key institutions at the state level. 3. Supporting people with mental health problems in returning to work with a pilot implementation of a comprehensive early vocational and employment rehabilitation model.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen projekta je vzpostaviti model celostne zgodnje poklicne in zaposlitvene rehabilitacije za osebe s težavami v duševnem zdravju, ki bo omogočal hitrejše in uspešnejše vračanje na delo, posledično (širši učinki) pa zmanjšanje trajanja bolniškega staleža in invalidskih upokojitev oziroma bo prispeval k povečanju ohranjanja zaposlenosti in socialne vključenosti navedene skupine oseb. Namen projekta je tudi oceniti uspešnost v projektu preizkušenega modela ter podpreti uvedbo potrebnih sistemskih sprememb za izvajanje celostne zgodnje poklicne in zaposlitvene rehabilitacije v Sloveniji. Cilji projekta so: 1. Priprava strokovnih podlag za celostno obravnavo oseb s težavami v duševnem zdravju s prilagoditvijo modela celostne zgodnje poklicne in zaposlitvene rehabilitacije v procesu vračanja na delo. 2. Dvig ozaveščenosti in informiranosti uporabnikov zdravstvenih storitev, delodajalcev, strokovne javnosti in ključnih inštitucij na ravni države. 3. Podpora osebam s težavami v duševnem zdravju pri vračanju na delo s pilotno implementacijo modela celostne zgodnje poklicne in zaposlitvene rehabilitacije.

Operation_Name_English: Libertas-Shortpoint of Cultures
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Libertas-stičišče kultur
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The renovation of the building and the transformation of the functional purpose of the ''Former Salt Warehouse at the Izola Gate - Libertas'' in Koper, which has been declared a cultural infrastructure since 2020, covers 1,548 m2 of built area, which is underutilised. The building, which is part of the historical environment and is located right next to the city centre, is not energy rehabilitated and does not allow the development of cultural activities in all its capacity. Salonite roof and roofing are worn out, the roof leaks in several places, there are no useful sanitary facilities in the room. The facility is currently underused and requires thorough renovation, transformation of the functionality of the premises and energy refurbishment. The project will be implemented within the framework of a mechanism of overall territorial investments aimed at overcoming the degradation and revitalisation of urban space. With the establishment of a cultural junction, early industrial architecture from the mid-19th century will acquire a new purpose. Libertas will become one of the most recognizable urban creative cultural platforms in the region. The reconstruction of the building and the arrangement of the surroundings will improve the urban environment and further revive the wider city centre, with the objectives of the investment being as follows: - reconstruction of a cultural monument of local importance next to the old city centre, - restoration and revitalisation of a cultural heritage facility and infrastructure, with a total usable area of 1,871.90 m2 net (building surfaces) and restoration of 917.00 m2 of outdoor surfaces, - adapted reuse of the historical built environment, the social aspect of land use will also improve, as after the implementation of the project, the area with new arrangements and cultural contents will become a dynamic, programmatically rich and socially vibrant, as well as a safer and more pleasant place, interesting also for repeated visits, both by residents and visitors of Koper.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prenova objekta in preobrazba funkcionalne namembnosti ''Nekdanjega skladišča soli ob Izolskih vratih – Libertas'' v Kopru, ki je od leta 2020 je razglašen za kulturno infrastrukturo, obsega 1.548 m2 zazidane površine, ki je slabo izkoriščena. Stavba, ki je del historičnega okolja in se nahaja tik ob mestnem jedru ni energetsko sanirana in ne omogoča razvoja kulturnih dejavnosti v vsej svoji zmogljivosti. Salonitna streha in ostrešje so dotrajani, streha na več mestih pušča, v prostoru ni uporabnih sanitarij. Objekt je trenutno slabo izkoriščen in je potreben temeljite prenove, preobrazbe funkcionalnosti prostorov in energetske sanacije. Projekt se bo izvedel v okviru mehanizma celotnih teritorialnih naložb, ki so namenjene odpravi degradacije in revitalizaciji urbanega prostora. Z vzpostavitvijo kulturnega stičišča bo zgodnja industrijska arhitektura iz sredine 19. stoletja dobila novo namembnost. Libertas bo postal ena izmed najbolj prepoznavnih urbanih ustvarjalnih kulturnih platform v regiji. Z rekonstrukcijo objekta in ureditvijo okolice se bo izboljšalo urbano okolje in še dodatno oživilo širše mesto središče, pri čemer so cilji investicije sledeči: - rekonstrukcija kulturnega spomenika lokalnega pomena ob starem mestnem jedru, - obnovitev in revitalizacija objekta kulturne dediščine in infrastrukture, s skupno uporabno površino 1.871,90 m2 neto (stavbnih površin) in obnova 917,00 m2 zunanjih površin, - prilagojena ponovna raba historičnega grajenega okolja, Izboljšal se bo tudi družbeni vidik rabe prostora, saj bo po izvedbi projekta območje z novimi ureditvami in kulturnimi vsebinami postalo dinamičen, programsko bogat in družbeno živahen ter varnejši in prijetnejši prostor, zanimiv tudi za večkraten obisk, tako prebivalcev kot obiskovalcev Kopra.

Operation_Name_English: Complete redevelopment of the area on Planina I from the Road of Hostages to the Road 1 May
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Celovita preureditev območja na Planini I od Ceste talcev do Ceste 1. maja
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: With the comprehensive redevelopment of the area between the Hostage Road and the Road on 1 May, which will include the arrangement of separate areas for cyclists and pedestrians from the carriageway with at least a minimum greenery, the area will be more safe and friendly for the two most vulnerable groups in traffic, pedestrians and cyclists. Disabled people and the blind and visually impaired were also considered in the planning of measures. The planned investment envisages a comprehensive redevelopment of the area on Planina I from the Road of Hostages to the Road on 1 May and is divided into several sections: 1. Planina north (reconstruction of the municipal road LZ 183582 from the Road of Hostages to the connection for the Sports Hall in the length of approximately 195 m), 2. Planina jug (reconstruction of the municipal road LZ 183582 from the import for Toplarno to the intersection with the road on 1 May in the length of approximately 277 m), 3rd connecting road "D" 1st phase (D13-D16), 4th parking lot, 5th meteor channel (MK3), 6th extension of the pavement between km 0+246 and 0+288, 7th connecting road D 2nd phase (D16-K8, K8-D24 and connector F) and 8. Circle K8. In total, the length of new and newly arranged pedestrian connections will be 1,242 meters and 1,351 meters for cyclists (in both directions). The project will implement the key measures needed to complete and upgrade the missing cycling infrastructure in a critical part of the neighbourhood, which will connect multi-apartment areas with vital central activities in the area: two elementary schools, a kindergarten, a central city cemetery and numerous business and commercial activities along the route. There is also a large shopping centre in the immediate vicinity of the route.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: S celovito preureditvijo območja med Cesto talcev in Cesto 1. maja, ki bo obsegala ureditev ločenih površin za kolesarje in pešce od vozišča vsaj z minimalno zelenico, bo obravnavano območje bolj varno in prijazno za dve najbolj ranljivi skupini v prometu, pešce in kolesarje. Pri načrtovanju ukrepov se je mislilo tudi invalide ter slepe in slabovidne. Načrtovana investicija predvideva celovito preureditev območja na Planini I od Ceste talcev do Ceste 1. maja in je razdeljena na več odsekov: 1. Planina sever (rekonstrukcija občinske ceste LZ 183582 od Ceste talcev do priključka za Športno dvorano v dolžini približno 195 m), 2. Planina jug (rekonstrukcija občinske ceste LZ 183582 od uvoza za Toplarno do križišča s Cesto 1. maja v dolžini približno 277 m), 3. povezovalna cesta »D« 1. faza (D13-D16), 4. parkirišče, 5. meteorni kanal (MK3), 6. razširitev pločnika med km 0+246 in 0+288, 7. povezovalna cesta D 2. faza (D16-K8, K8-D24 in priključek F) in 8. Krožišče K8. Skupaj bo dolžina novih in novo urejenih povezav za pešce znašala 1.242 metrov oziroma 1.351 metrov za kolesarje (v obe smeri). S projektom bodo izvedeni ključni ukrepi, potrebni za dopolnitev in dograditev manjkajoče kolesarske infrastrukture na kritičnem delu soseske, s katerim se bo kolesarsko povezalo večstanovanjska območja z vitalnimi centralnimi dejavnostmi na območju: dvema osnovnima šolama, vrtcem, osrednjim mestnim pokopališčem in številnimi poslovno-trgovskimi dejavnostmi vzdolž trase. V neposredni bližini trase je tudi večje nakupovano središče.

Operation_Name_English: Raising the professionalisation of public procurement (ProfJN)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dvig profesionalizacije javnega naročanja (ProfJN)
Category_Label: Support for adult education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The programme is connected to the existing e-JN project, which is implemented within the Public Procurement Directorate, where additional modalities will be developed in the e-JN information system (e-procurement system project), which represents an information system for the electronic management of the entire public procurement procedure, in which representatives of both contracting authorities and economic operators can perform individual actions in public procurement procedures. The programme Raising Professionalisation of Public Procurement (ProfJN) is in synergy with this project, as both want to support stakeholders in the field of content and information in order to make public procurement procedures easier, faster and of higher quality. The digital content developed within ProfJN will be published as part of the e-JN information system, which represents a single entry point for the electronic public procurement system owned by the MJU. The purpose of the investment is to raise the qualifications of persons performing public contracts, which will be reflected in their more efficient and better quality work. The programme will contribute to the professionalisation of stakeholders involved in public procurement procedures (representatives of contracting authorities and tenderers) with the aim of improving and facilitating the implementation of procedures. The Academy will operate as a non-institutional programme within the MJU and in cooperation with the Administrative Academy. In addition, the existing content helpdesk will continue its work in the form of the so-called help center for comprehensive content help in the field of public procurement.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Program se povezuje z obstoječim projektom e-JN, ki ga izvajamo v okviru Direktorata za javno naročanje, kjer se bodo razvijale dodatne modalitete v informacijskem sistemu e-JN (projekt Sistem e-javnega naročanja), ki predstavlja informacijski sistem za elektronsko vodenje celotnega postopka javnega naročanja, v katerem predstavniki tako naročnikov kot gospodarskih subjektov lahko opravljajo posamezna dejanja v postopkih javnih naročil. Program Dvig profesionalizacije javnega naročanja (ProfJN) je v sinergiji s tem projektom, saj oba želita, eden na vsebinskem, drugi pa na informacijskem področju, podpreti deležnike, da bodo lažje, hitreje in bolj kvalitetno izvajali postopke javnih naročil. Digitalne vsebine, razvite v okviru ProfJN, bodo objavljene v sklopu informacijskega sistema e-JN, ki predstavlja enotno vstopno točko za elektronski sistem javnega naročanja v lasti MJU. Namen investicije je dvig usposobljenosti oseb, ki izvajajo javna naročila, kar se bo odražalo v njihovem učinkovitejšem in kakovostnejšem delu. Program bo prispeval k profesionalizaciji deležnikov, ki sodelujejo v postopkih javnega naročanja (predstavniki naročnikov in ponudnikov) s ciljem boljšega in lažjega izvajanja postopkov. Akademija bo delovala kot neinstitucionalni program v okviru MJU in v sodelovanju z Upravno akademijo. Poleg tega pa bo obstoječa enota za vsebinsko pomoč uporabnikom delo nadaljevala v obliki t.i. help centra za celovito vsebinsko pomoč na področju javnega naročanja.

Operation_Name_English: Systemic treatment of fragility with an emphasis on pre-fragility for healthy and quality ageing

Operation_Name_English: Innovative lifting bed with lifting mechanism
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativna dvižna postelja z dvižnim mehanizmom
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the submitted project, the company is developing a lift bed, which is the result of its own development and will allow users to make additional use of space and thus reduce their living costs. The lift bed will offer a variety of layout options, easy installation and ease of use, and will allow for the possibility of repositioning. It will represent a universal solution, as it will be suitable for different heights of the room, different sizes of the bed and different layouts in the room. From competing products, the company's product differs with an innovative mechanism for raising the bed and an innovative way of folding the legs of the bed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru prijavljenega projekta podjetje razvija dvižno posteljo, ki je plod lastnega razvoja in bo uporabnikom omogočala dodatno izrabo prostora in jim s tem zniževala stroške bivanja. Dvižna postelja bo ponujala različne možnosti postavitve, enostavno montažo in enostavno uporabo ter bo omogočala možnost premeščanja. Predstavljala bo univerzalno rešitev, saj bo primerna za različne višine prostora, različne velikosti postelje in različne postavitve v prostoru. Od konkurenčnih izdelkov se produkt podjetja razlikuje z inovativnim mehanizmom za dvig postelje in inovativnim načinom zlaganje nog postelje.

Operation_Name_English: Development of digital publishing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj digitalnega založništva
Category_Label: IT services and applications for digital skills and digital inclusion
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the funding is the digitisation of the book or publishing sector, since the processes of production and content of books must be digitised and advanced technologies must be introduced into publishing, while at the same time increasing the digital competence of publishers (educating publishers about the use of software, knowledge about forms of protection of materials, copyright and related rights, the use of corpora for publishers and authors, etc.). The digital transformation of publishing involves the digitalisation of business models, services as well as products. In particular, the production of quality audio books that are not machine-readable is not at a satisfactory level due to the high production costs that cannot be covered by sales or rental fees. Only continuous and high-quality production of audio books with the introduction of artificial intelligence and other advanced technological solutions can establish a more stable development of this field. It is necessary to provide the public with a digital user experience through both products (audio and e-books) and an improved and equal way of accessing this content from anywhere, as well as to improve the digital and reading literacy of the population. By ceding the texts of the newly created audio and e-books to researchers and language technology companies for the purpose of corpus production, it also contributes to the development of Slovene in the digital environment. Objectives of funding: – Production of e-books and quality non-machine read audiobooks in Slovenian Digitalisation of the process of producing books and the content of books (production of e-books and audiobooks). – Raising the digital competence of publishers Provision of training for publishers on the use of software, knowledge of forms of protection, copyright and related rights, use of corpora to increase the digital competence of publishers. – Enhancing accessibility to digital books Greater digital inclusion of the population and better accessibility, as well as a digital user experience of the book. Improving the digital as well as reading literacy of the population. – Provision of basic elements of the language infrastructure Distribution of texts of newly created audio and e-books to research organisations and companies in the field of language technologies with a view to the production of corpora that are the basis for the development of language technologies in Slovene.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen financiranja je digitalizacija področja knjige oziroma založništva, saj je procese izdelave in vsebine knjig treba digitalizirati in v založništvo uvesti napredne tehnologije, vzporedno s tem pa tudi dvigniti digitalne kompetence založnikov (izobraziti založnike o uporabi programske opreme, poznavanju oblik zaščite gradiv, avtorskih in sorodnih pravicah, uporabi korpusov za založnike in avtorje ipd.). Digitalna preobrazba založništva vključuje digitalizacijo poslovnih modelov, storitev kot tudi produktov. Predvsem produkcija kakovostnih zvočnih knjig, ki niso strojno brane, zaradi visokih stroškov izdelave, ki jih ni mogoče pokriti s prodajo ali nadomestilom za izposojo, ni na zadovoljivi ravni. Samo stalna in kakovostna produkcija zvočnih knjig ob uvajanju umetne inteligence in drugih naprednih tehnoloških rešitev lahko vzpostavi stabilnejši razvoj tega področja. Javnosti je treba tako s produkti (zvočnimi in e-knjigami) kot tudi z izboljšanim in enakopravnim načinom dostopnosti do teh vsebin od koder koli omogočiti digitalno uporabniško izkušnjo ter izboljšati digitalno in tudi bralno pismenost prebivalstva. Z odstopom besedil novonastalih zvočnih in e-knjig raziskovalcem in jezikovnotehnološkim podjetjem za namen izdelave korpusov pa se prispeva tudi k razvoju slovenščine v digitalnem okolju. Cilji financiranja: – Izdelava e-knjig in kakovostnih nestrojno branih zvočnih knjig v slovenščini Digitalizacija procesa izdelave knjig in vsebine knjig (izdelava e-knjig in zvočnih knjig). – Dvig digitalnih kompetenc založnikov Izvedba izobraževanj založnikov o uporabi programske opreme, poznavanju oblik zaščite, avtorskih in sorodnih pravicah, uporabi korpusov za dvig digitalnih kompetenc založnikov. – Izboljšanje dostopnosti do digitalnih knjig Večja digitalna vključenost prebivalstva in boljša dostopnost ter digitalna uporabniška izkušnja na področju knjige. Izboljšanje digitalne in tudi bralne pismenosti prebivalstva. – Zagotavljanje osnovnih gradnikov jezikovne infrastrukture Distribucija besedil novonastalih zvočnih in e-knjig raziskovalnim organizacijam in podjetjem s področja jezikovnih tehnologij z namenom izdelave korpusov, ki so podlaga za razvoj jezikovnih tehnologij v slovenščini.

Operation_Name_English: Upgraded ProbIS information system, with access to advisory modules
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nadgrajen informacijski sistem ProbIS, z dostopi do svetovalno edukativnih modulov
Category_Label: Government ICT solutions, e-services, applications
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the investment project is to enable persons in probation to have access to comprehensive support services that will contribute to the successful execution of criminal sanctions, improve their quality of life and reduce the risk of reoffending. The support services will be available in the form of digitalised counselling and education modules (SEM), which will be accessed by people with a username and password. Access will be voluntary, based on a previously performed Risk and Needs Assessment (MOT) model that identifies criminogen factors and strong areas of the individual. The digitalisation of the MOT will make it possible to draw up precise personal plans on the basis of which persons will be directed to specific areas of the SEM. The target groups of the project include probationers and institutions involved in the probation process. With the use of an extended information system, people in probation will receive more effective and personalized professional treatment, which can help to reintegrate people into society and reduce the risk of reoffending. In addition, the extension will improve the work of probation staff and other stakeholders involved by enabling faster resolution of cases and improving the quality of cooperation between institutions, optimising judicial and probation processes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen investicijskega projekta je omogočiti osebam v probaciji dostop do celovitih podpornih storitev, ki bodo prispevale k uspešni izvršitvi kazenskih sankcij, izboljšanju njihove kakovosti življenja ter zmanjšanju tveganj za ponovitve kaznivih dejanj. Podporne storitve bodo na voljo v obliki digitaliziranih svetovalno-izobraževalnih modulov (SEM), do katerih bodo osebe dostopale z uporabniškim imenom in geslom. Dostopanje bo prostovoljno, na podlagi predhodno opravljenega modela za ocenjevanje tveganj in potreb (MOT), ki prepoznava kriminogene dejavnike in močna področja posameznika. Digitalizacija MOT bo omogočila izdelavo natančnih osebnih načrtov, na podlagi katerih se bodo osebe usmerjale na specifična področja SEM. Ciljne skupine projekta vključujejo osebe v probaciji in institucije, ki sodelujejo v probacijski obravnavi. Z uporabo razširjenega informacijskega sistema bodo osebe v probaciji deležne bolj učinkovite in personalizirane strokovne obravnave, kar lahko pripomore k reintegraciji oseb v družbo in zmanjšanju tveganj za ponovitev kaznivih dejanj. Poleg tega bo razširitev izboljšala delo probacijskih uslužbencev in drugih sodelujočih deležnikov, saj bo omogočila hitrejše reševanje primerov in izboljšala kakovost sodelovanja med institucijami, kar bo optimiziralo pravosodne in probacijske procese.

Operation_Name_English: Reducing flood risks along the Dravinja and Polskava rivers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zmanjševanje poplavne ogroženosti ob Dravinji in Polskavi
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will reduce the flood risk at the OPVP Poljčane in the municipalities of Slovenske Konjice, Videm, Kidričevo, Majšperk and Slovenska Bistrica. The planned integrated measures to improve flood safety along the Dravinja and Polskava rivers will reduce the flood risk in the wider area under consideration, while ensuring a limited impact of climate change on the flood risk of the area in the long term.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: S projektom se bo zmanjšala poplavna ogroženost na OPVP Poljčane, in sicer na območju občin Slovenske Konjice, Videm, Kidričevo, Majšperk in Slovenska Bistrica. Z načrtovanimi celostnimi ukrepi za izboljšanje poplavne varnosti ob Dravinji in Polskavi bo zmanjšana poplavna ogroženost na širšem obravnavanem območju, hkrati pa bo dolgoročno zagotovljen omejen vpliv podnebnih sprememb na poplavno ogroženost območja.

Operation_Name_English: Execution of the Linhart road, section from Dunajska cesta to the roundabout Žale
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izvedba Linhartove ceste, odsek od Dunajske ceste do krožišča Žale
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The Linhart Road represents a two-lane urban road with a total length of approx. 1400 m, which connects the area of Novi Jars and the Sava settlement with the area of Bežigrad and the city centre. One of the main reasons for the investment is the durability and safety inadequacy of the motorised and non-motorised area in this part of the Linhart road. The investment will increase the safety of all road users and improve the living conditions of the inhabitants of this part of the city of Ljubljana. Further deterioration of the running surface and growth in the costs of ongoing and capital maintenance of the infrastructure will be prevented. The expansion of the Linhart road will eliminate the capacity inadequacy of the road on the section in question, and together with the latter will eliminate congestion and traffic delays during peak periods. As part of the project, all surfaces intended for cycling and walking traffic will be reconstructed. As part of the interventions, it is envisaged to change the traffic profile into a four-lane road with yellow lanes, which will be intended for public passenger transport. The reconstruction will provide more spacious and safer areas for pedestrians and cyclists, as well as more attractive public passenger transport, improve conditions for people with disabilities, and allow more greening and better conditions for tree growth. Four junctions (Vienna, Železna, Neuberger, Topniška cesta) and a new junction with Valjhun Street with a pedestrian and cyclist crossing will also be renovated. Cycling trails and pavements along the entire Linhart road will be redesigned. Through the renovation of Linhart Street between the section of Dunajska cesta and the Žale roundabout, the City of Ljubljana aims to promote sustainable multimodal urban mobility, thereby also achieving several goals, namely a higher share of cyclists in traffic, a higher share of pedestrians, a reduction in the number of traffic accidents, the promotion of sustainable mobility, the promotion of the use of PPPs, the improvement of air quality in cities and an improved connection of urban areas with their hinterland.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Linhartova cesta predstavlja dvopasovno mestno cesto v skupni dolžini ca. 1400 m, ki povezuje območje Novih Jarš in Savskega naselja z območje Bežigrada ter ožjim mestnim središčem. Eden izmed glavnih razlogov za izvedbo investicije je dotrajanost in varnostna neustreznost motorizirane in nemotorizirane površine na tem predelu Linhartove ceste. Z investicijo se bo povečala varnost vseh udeležencev v prometu ter izboljšale bivalne razmere prebivalcev tega dela mesta Ljubljana. Preprečilo se bo nadaljnje propadanje vozne površine ter rast stroškov tekočega in investicijskega vzdrževanja infrastrukture. S širitvijo Linhartove ceste se bo odpravila kapacitetna neustreznost ceste na obravnavanem odseku, skupaj s slednjo pa se bodo odpravili še zastoji in zamude v prometu v času prometnih konic. V sklopu projekta bodo rekonstruirane vse površine namenjene kolesarskemu in peš prometu. V sklopu posegov je predvidena sprememba prometnega profila v štiripasovnico z rumenimi pasovi, ki bodo namenjeni javnemu potniškemu prometu. Rekonstrukcija bo zagotovila prostornejše in varnejše površine za pešce in kolesarje ter privlačnejši javni potniški promet, izboljšala bo razmere za osebe z oviranostmi ter omogočila več ozelenitve in boljše razmere za rast dreves. Preurejena bodo tudi štiri križišča (Dunajska, Železna, Neubergerjeva, Topniška cesta) ter novo križišče z Valjhunovo ulico s prehodom za pešce in kolesarje. Na novo bodo urejene kolesarske steze in pločniki vzdolž celotne Linhartove ceste. Mestna občina Ljubljana želi preko prenove Linhartove ulice med odsekom Dunajske ceste in krožiščem Žale spodbuditi trajnostno multimodalno urbano mobilnost, s tem bodo dosegli tudi več ciljev in sicer večji delež kolesarjev v prometu, večji delež peščev, zmanjšanje števila prometnih nesreč, spodbujanje trajnostne mobilnosti, spodbujanje uporabe JPP, izboljšanje kakovosti zraka v mestih ter izboljšano povezanost urbanih območij z njihovim zaledjem.

Multigenerational Centre+ (VGC+) is a central gathering place in the local environment, dedicated to socializing, maintaining or expanding the social network and empowering vulnerable groups. It is a preventive project involving educational, intercultural, intergenerational and other activities.

Operation_Name_English: SUPPORT TO UNDERSTAND WORK ACTIVITIES-ASI+
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PODPORA PODJETJEM ZA PODALJŠEVANJE DELOVNE AKTIVNOSTI-ASI+
Category_Label: Measures encouraging active and healthy ageing
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the ASI operation is to prolong the work activity of older employees by strengthening their competences, eliminating stereotypes about older employees and empowering employers to manage an ageing workforce, and promoting intergenerational cooperation through the transfer of knowledge between generations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije ASI je podaljševanje delovne aktivnosti starejših zaposlenih s krepitvijo njihovih kompetenc, odpravo stereotipov o starejših zaposlenih in opolnomočenju delodajalcev za upravljanje starajoče se delovne sile ter spodbujanje medgeneracijskega sodelovanja s prenosom znanj med generacijami.

Operation_Name_English: Energy Poverty Reduction Programme 2024-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Program zmanjševanja energetske revščine 2024-2027
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The ZER programme 2024-2027 aims to implement investments in energy efficiency measures and the use of renewable energy sources in an estimated 1100 households in energy poverty (of which 620 households in less developed regions and 480 households in more developed regions) in order to reduce the growing problem of energy poverty. In order to reduce energy poverty as much as possible, it is necessary to implement a combination of different measures, whereby improving the energy performance of buildings is the best long-term measure. The funds will therefore be used to the greatest extent possible for investment measures and for advice and measures to change behavioural habits in the management of energy sources. In order to identify households that actually face energy poverty, the funds will also be used for support measures, i.e. for so-called coordinators, who will inform potential beneficiaries, help them to apply for a public call and guide them throughout the process of implementing investment measures. The implementation of the programme will thus be set up in such a way that the beneficiaries will be provided with comprehensive support, namely to help them understand the measures to improve the energy efficiency of buildings, the procedure relating to applying for funding and, if the conditions of the public call are met, the implementation of investment measures. Since low-income households cannot afford the energy renovation of their buildings, the amount of the non-repayable financial incentive for the implementation of investment measures will amount to up to 100% of the eligible investment costs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Program ZER 2024- 2027 je namenjen izvedbi investicij v ukrepe učinkovite rabe energije in rabe obnovljivih virov energije v predvidoma 1100 energetsko revnih gospodinjstvih (od tega v 620 gospodinjstvih v manj razvitih regijah in 480 v bolj razvitih regijah) z namenom zmanjšanja naraščajočega problema energetske revščine. Da bi v čim večji meri zmanjšali energetsko revščino, je potrebno izvesti kombinacijo različnih ukrepov, pri čemer je izboljšanje energetske učinkovitosti stavb najboljši dolgoročni ukrep. Sredstva bodo tako v največjem obsegu namenjena investicijskim ukrepom ter svetovanju in ukrepom za spremembe vedenjskih navad pri ravnanju z viri energije. Z namenom identificiranja gospodinjstev, ki se dejansko soočajo z energetsko revščino pa bodo sredstva namenjena tudi za podporne ukrepe, to je za t. i. koordinatorje, ki bodo informirali potencialne upravičence, jim pomagali pri prijavi na javni poziv ter jih vodili skozi celoten postopek izvedbe investicijskih ukrepov. Izvedba programa bo tako zastavljena na način, da bo upravičencem zagotovljena celovita podpora, in sicer kot pomoč pri razumevanju ukrepov v izboljšanje energetske učinkovitosti stavb, pri postopku v zvezi s kandidiranjem za pridobitev sredstev ter v primeru izpolnjevanja pogojev javnega poziva, pri izvedbe investicijskih ukrepov. Ker si gospodinjstva z nizkimi prihodki ne morejo privoščiti energetske obnove njihovih stavb, bo višina nepovratne finančne spodbude za izvedbo investicijskih ukrepov znašala do 100 % upravičenih stroškov investicij.

Operation_Name_English: Self-confident Critically Responsible Creative in the DIGI FUTURE
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Samozavestno Kritično Odgovorno Kreativno V DIGI PRIHODNOST
Category_Label: IT services and applications for digital skills and digital inclusion
Operation_Summary_English: Non-formal education "Jump into the Digi Future" follows the DigiComp 2.2 guidelines and covers all 5 areas of digital competence. 21 digital competences are included in both educational programmes (basic and advanced) and will be addressed through the non-formal educational process. The topic of 222 Digi info points will be included as an additional content of non-formal education. Participants will be presented where they can find a list of locations and check the official hours of active Digi info points, as well as what services they offer as citizens of the Republic of Slovenia. Depending on the location of the training, each participant will also obtain information about the location of the nearest Digi info point.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Neformalno izobraževanje »Skok v digi prihodnost« sledi smernicam DigiComp 2.2 in pokriva vseh 5 področij digitalnih kompetenc. V oba izobraževalna programa (osnovni in napredni) je vključenih in bo skozi neformalni izobraževalni proces obravnavanih 21 digitalnih kompetenc. Kot dodatna vsebina neformalnega izobraževanja bo vključena tema o 222 Digi info točkah. Udeležencem bo predstavljeno, kje najdejo seznam lokacij in preverijo uradne ure aktivnih Digi info točk, ter kakšne storitve jim kot državljanom RS nudijo. Vsak udeleženec bo glede na lokacijo izobraževanja tudi pridobil informacijo, kje se nahaja udeležencu najbližja lokacija Digi info točke.

Operation_Name_English: Reduction of flood risk in the Savinja basin - Lot 1
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zmanjšanje poplavne ogroženosti na porečju Savinje -1. sklop
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the planned investment is to ensure adequate flood safety against the high waters of the Savinja River and its tributaries in the area of the municipalities of Braslovče, Polzela and Laško, which will significantly reduce the flood risk in the wider Savinja River Basin area. The objective will be achieved through the implementation of comprehensive measures to improve the flow of watercourses, the construction of flood protection infrastructure and the establishment and activation of spillage areas. The measures include the arrangement of the section of the Savinja River between Grobeljski most and Mali Braslovče (in the area of the Ločica-Letuš NPP), including dykes, walls, flow-through facilities and nature-based solutions, as well as local measures to protect the area of Rečica in Debru (Laško), where dykes and arrangements for the retention and channelling of high waters will be implemented.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osnovni cilj načrtovane investicije je zagotovitev ustrezne poplavne varnosti pred visokimi vodami Savinje in njenih pritokov na območju občin Braslovče, Polzela in Laško, s čimer se bo bistveno zmanjšala poplavna ogroženost širšega območja porečja Savinje. Cilj bo dosežen z izvedbo celovitih ukrepov za izboljšanje pretočnosti vodotokov, izgradnjo protipoplavne infrastrukture ter vzpostavitvijo in aktivacijo razlivnih površin. Ukrepi zajemajo ureditev odseka reke Savinje med Grobeljskim mostom in Malimi Braslovčami (na območju DPN Ločica–Letuš), vključno z nasipi, zidovi, pretočnimi objekti in na naravi temelječimi rešitvami, ter lokalne ukrepe za zaščito območja Rečice v Debru (Laško), kjer bodo izvedeni nasipi in ureditve za zadrževanje in usmerjanje visokih voda.

Operation_Name_English: DigiModern
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DigiModrejši
Category_Label: IT services and applications for digital skills and digital inclusion
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the operation is to acquire basic digital competences of residents of the Republic of Slovenia aged 30 years or more. Strengthening competences in this age group can have an impact on promoting greater civic inclusion and employment, as it is important for employers that employees have digital competences in different fields. By participating in training sessions, participants raise awareness of the benefits of using digital tools for the life of the individual and society as a whole, and build trust in digital technologies, understanding digital technologies and using them responsibly and safely. Digitalisation is becoming a necessity and broad-based digital skills are becoming the backbone of society. However, in order to be able to trust digital products and services, individuals must learn to use the information available on the World Wide Web, learn to recognise disinformation and fraud attempts, and be able to protect themselves from online fraud and scams.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije je pridobivanje osnovnih digitalnih kompetenc prebivalcev Republike Slovenije starih 30 let ali več. Krepitev kompetenc v tej starostni skupini ima lahko vpliv na spodbujanje večje državljanske vključenosti in zaposlovanja, saj je za delodajalce pomembno, da imajo zaposleni digitalne kompetence iz različnih področij. Z udeležbo na izobraževanjih udeleženci krepijo zavest o prednostih uporabe digitalnih orodij za življenje posameznika in družbo kot celoto ter krepijo zaupanje v digitalne tehnologije, razumevanje digitalnih tehnologij ter njihove odgovorne in varne uporabe. Digitalizacija postaja nujnost in široko zasnovane digitalne spretnosti in znanja postajajo temelj družbe. Da pa posameznik lahko zaupa digitalnim proizvodom in storitvam, se mora naučiti uporabljati informacije, ki so na voljo na svetovnem spletu, naučiti se morajo prepoznati dezinformacije in poskuse goljufij in znati se morajo zaščititi pred spletnimi prevarami in goljufijami.

Operation_Name_English: Arrangement of the Seidl road
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ureditev Seidlove ceste
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the investment is to ensure greater traffic safety for pedestrians and cyclists, reduce the negative impacts of motor traffic on the environment, promote sustainable mobility and the use of bicycles for everyday tasks as an alternative to car transport. Additional effects of the investment are enabling the development of recreational activities of people and thus a positive impact on their health. The objective of the investment is the arrangement of a bus stop at the intersection of Seidlova cesta and Koštialova ulica and the reconstruction of the local road LG-299272 (Seidlova cesta) with the arrangement of surfaces for cyclists and pedestrians on the section from Križišče with Cankarjeva ulica towards Ločna from km approx. 2,755 to km 3,325 in the length of 570 m. The implementation of the project will contribute to the achievement of impact and result indicators under the European Cohesion Policy Programme 2021-2027 in Slovenia, priority 4 "Sustainable mobility", specific objective RSO2.8 "Promoting sustainable multimodal urban mobility in the context of the transition to a net-zero carbon economy".
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen investicije je zagotavljanje večje prometne varnosti peščev in kolesarjev, zmanjševanje negativnih vplivov motornega prometa na okolje, vzpodbujanje trajnostne mobilnosti in uporabe koles za vsakodnevna opravila, kot alternative avtomobilskim prevozom. Dodatni učinki investicije so še omogočanje razvoja rekreativne dejavnosti ljudi in s tem pozitivni vpliv na njihovo zdravje. Cilj investicije je ureditev avtobusnega postajališča v križišču Seidlove ceste in Koštialove ulice ter rekonstrukcija lokalne ceste LG-299272 (Seidlova cesta) z ureditvijo površin za kolesarje in pešce na odseku od Križišča s Cankarjevo ulico proti Ločni od km cca 2,755 do km 3,325 v dolžini 570 m. Izvedba projekta bo prispevala k doseganju kazalnikov učinka in kazalnikov rezultata v okviru Programa evropske kohezijske politike v obdobju 2021-2027 v Sloveniji, prednostna naloga 4 »Trajnostna mobilnost«, specifični cilj RSO2.8. »Spodbujanje trajnostne večmodalne mestne mobilnosti v okviru prehoda na gospodarstvo z ničelno stopnjo neto emisij ogljika«.

Operation_Name_English: Advanced ergonomic armrest based on cellular structures made of flexible materials
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Napredni ergonomski naslon za roko na osnovi celičnih struktur iz fleksibilnih materialov
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The operation consists of the development and production of ultralight flexible products based on cellular structures, which will be printed with advanced 3D printing technology. This enables them to develop affordable ergonomic products with an exceptional biomechanical response, breathability, up to 80% less weight than comparable products and no waste in production. The goal is to develop an ergonomic armrest with cellular structure (structure based on a network of interconnected cells and other natural forms) and the possibility of full personalization in an online configurator; with the main goal of reducing occupational diseases such as carpal tunnel syndrome. The focus is on the use of sustainable materials and local production of all components.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija obsega razvoj in proizvodnjo ultralahkih fleksibilnih izdelkov na osnovi celičnih struktur, ki jih bodo tiskali z napredno tehnologijo 3D tiska. Le ta omogoča, da bodo lahko razvili cenovno ugodne ergonomske izdelke z izjemnim biomehanskim odzivom, zračnostjo, do 80% manjšo maso napram primerljivim izdelkom in brez odpada pri proizvodnji. Cilj je razviti ergonomski naslon za roko z celično strukturo (strukturo na osnovi mreže med seboj povezanih celic in ostalih naravnih oblik) in možnostjo popolne personalizacije v spletnem konfiguratorju; z glavnim ciljem zmanjšanja poklicnih bolezni, kot je sindrom karpalnega kanala. Fokus je na uporabi trajnostnih materialov in lokalni proizvodnji vseh komponent.

Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the call for tenders ‘Patient – Career’ 2024-2026 is to establish measures for verified training for the profession of ‘Patient – Career’ and to establish a new traineeship programme for the profession of ‘Patient – Career’. With JR Bolničar – caregiver 2024-2026, we want to establish a model of verified training for work in health and long-term care, improve the health system in Slovenia with the aim of establishing stable and accessible health care and ensuring quality health services. The purpose of this call for tenders is also to improve the responsiveness of the education and training system to the needs of the labour market, to reduce the labour market deficits of this profession, to improve the attractiveness of vocational education for the "patient-carer" profile and to ensure the effective provision of training for this profession. The NEB will be implemented as part of the measure Strengthening the resilience of the long-term care system
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen javnega razpisa Bolničar – negovalec 2024–2026 je vzpostavitev ukrepov za verificirano usposabljanje za poklic »bolničar – negovalec« ter vzpostavitev novega programa pripravništva za poklic »bolničar – negovalec«. Z JR Bolničar – negovalec 2024–2026 želimo vzpostaviti model verificiranega usposabljanja za delo v zdravstvu in dolgotrajni oskrbi, izboljšati zdravstveni sistem v RS z namenom vzpostavitve stabilnega in dostopnega zdravstva in zagotovitvijo kakovostnih zdravstvenih storitev. Namen tega javnega razpisa je tudi izboljšanje odzivnost sistema izobraževanja in usposabljanja na potrebe trga dela, zmanjšati deficitarnosti tega poklica na trgu dela, izboljšati privlačnost poklicnega izobraževanja za profil »bolničar – negovalec« ter zagotoviti učinkovito izvajanje usposabljanja za ta poklic. Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the project, the development and upgrade of the Humanodoro Pad product (and related applications) will continue to address the problem of excessive use of mobile devices. The goal is, on the one hand, to increase the productivity of the individual, and on the other hand, to improve the state of health. The product is a smart foundation that acts as a dedicated space for the phone and helps the user to reduce “screen time”. It connects to the Humanodoro app, where the user sets up challenges, monitors analytics and connects with friends. Gamification and community create additional motivation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru projekta se bo nadaljevalo z razvojem ter nadgradnjo produkta Humanodoro Pad (ter pripadajoče aplikacije) za reševanje problema prekomerne rabe mobilnih naprav. Cilj je po eni strani dvig produktivnosti posameznika, po drugi pa boljše zdravstveno stanje. Produkt je pametna podlaga, ki deluje kot dediciran prostor za telefon in uporabniku pomaga zmanjšati “screen time”. Poveže se z aplikacijo Humanodoro, kjer uporabnik nastavi izzive, spremlja analitiko in se povezuje s prijatelji. Gamifikacija in skupnost ustvarjajo dodatno motivacijo.

Operation_Summary_English: The operation will enable the acquisition of practical experience, knowledge and competences of students in the work environment during their studies, encourage the strengthening of cooperation and integration and transfer of knowledge between the higher education system and the work environment (the economy and the non-economy and non-profit sector in the local and regional environment). In this way, young people will be able to develop their skills in the realization of ideas, the development of entrepreneurship, innovation, creative and critical thinking, creativity, etc. for greater employability and easier transition into the working environment after the completion of their studies. The call also addresses other challenges of higher education, such as the systemic introduction of knowledge transfer between higher education institutions and the working environment, greater flexibility and adaptation of study programmes to the needs of the labour market, and the establishment of long-term cooperation between higher education institutions and the working environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije bo omogočeno pridobivanje praktičnih izkušenj, znanj in kompetenc študentov v delovnem okolju v času študija, spodbujanje krepitve sodelovanja in povezovanja ter prenosa znanja med visokošolskim sistemom in med delovnim okoljem (gospodarstvo ter negospodarstvo in neprofitni sektor v lokalnem in regionalnem okolju). Na ta način se bo mladim omogočalo razvoj znanj in spretnosti pri uresničevanju idej, razvoj podjetnosti, inovativnosti, kreativnega in kritičnega razmišljanja, ustvarjalnosti ipd. za večjo zaposljivost in lažji prehod v delovno okolje po zaključku študija. Category_Label: Measures to improve access to employment
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the operation is to provide employed persons whose employment or self-employment is at risk, temporary or precarious, with appropriate competences to facilitate the transition to the labour market and prevent the transition to open unemployment. Indirectly, the operation is also intended to help employers to acquire suitably qualified employees. The target group will be included in retention programmes. These are targeted programmes that cover different forms of information, motivation, career guidance, training or education and will be adapted to the needs of the labour market. These will include knowledge to strengthen digital competences, knowledge for the green transition and the circular economy, and knowledge for social development in general. This will facilitate the transition to new jobs or jobs and prevent them from moving into unemployment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije je zaposlenim osebam, katerih zaposlitev oz. samozaposlitev je ogrožena, začasna ali prekarna, zagotoviti ustrezne kompetence za lažji prehod na trg delovne sile ter preprečiti prehod v odprto brezposelnost. Gre za ciljni skupini prilagojene programe, ki zajemajo različne oblike informiranja, motiviranja, kariernega svetovanja, usposabljanja ali izobraževanja in bodo prilagojena potrebam trga dela. Le ti bodo vključevali znanja za krepitev digitalnih kompetenc, znanja za zeleni prehod in krožno gospodarstvo ter znanja za družbeni razvoj nasploh. Na tak način se bo omogočal lažji prehod na nova delovna mesta ali v novo zaposlitev in preprečevalo njihov prehod v brezposelnost.

Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurship over challenges in the Podravska region
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive v Podravski regiji
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Podravje is part of the comprehensive project PONI, which is carried out throughout Slovenia. The purpose of the PONI Podravje operation is the entrepreneurial training of people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Podravje region. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Podravje je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Podravje je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Podravski regiji. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the call for tenders ‘Patient – Career’ 2024-2026 is to establish measures for verified training for the profession of ‘Patient – Career’ and to establish a new traineeship programme for the profession of ‘Patient – Career’. Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen javnega razpisa Bolničar – negovalec 2024–2026 je vzpostavitev ukrepov za verificirano usposabljanje za poklic »bolničar – negovalec« ter vzpostavitev novega programa pripravništva za poklic »bolničar – negovalec«. Operation_Name_English: Sports-recreational and preventive programmes for health promotion and activation of all generations
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Športno-rekreacijski in preventivni programi za krepitev zdravja in aktiviranje vseh generacij
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Move to exercise" is designed in the direction of establishing a network of quality professionally managed sports-recreational and preventive programmes for health promotion and activation of the adult population, which will be implemented by selected sports associations, sports federations and other providers of sports programmes defined by the Sports Act (ZŠpo-1). The establishment of conditions for the implementation and training of individuals in sports and recreational training programmes, which will be carried out in the range of at least 60 hours per year, representing at least 30 training weeks of two hours per week, will be co-financed. The exercise will be carried out and accompanied exclusively by an expert in sport as defined by ZŠpo-1. Each individual will be provided with physical capacity testing and progress monitoring as part of the project. The aim of the project will be to increase the proportion of physically active adults in Slovenia by establishing the conditions for their inclusion in professionally managed sports and recreational training programmes. The implementation of sports and recreational programmes at the local level will ensure location accessibility and enable (if necessary, additionally encourage) the individual to come to the exercise on foot, by bicycle or public transport. This will have an additional impact on the reduction of harmful health behaviours and on the reduction of health risks arising from pollution.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt »Zmigaj se do vadbe« je zasnovan v smeri, da se vzpostavi mreža kakovostnih strokovno vodenih športno-rekreativnih in preventivnih programov za krepitev zdravja in aktivacijo odrasle populacije, ki jih bodo izvajala izbrana športna društva, športne zveze in drugi izvajalci športnih programov, ki jih opredeljuje Zakon o športu (ZŠpo-1). Sofinanciralo se bo vzpostavitev pogojev za izvedbo ter vadbo posameznikov v programih športno-rekreativne vadbe, ki se bodo izvajali v obsegu najmanj 60 ur letno, kar predstavlja najmanj 30 vadbenih tednov po dve uri tedensko. Vadbo bo lahko izvajal in spremljal izključno strokovni delavec v športu kot ga opredeljuje ZŠpo-1. Vsakemu posamezniku bo v okviru projekta zagotovljeno testiranje telesnih zmogljivosti in spremljanje napredka. Cilj projekta bo povečanje deleža telesno dejavnih odraslih prebivalcev Slovenije z vzpostavljanjem pogojev za njihovo vključitev v strokovno vodene športno-rekreativne programe vadbe. Z izvajanjem športno-rekreativnih programov na lokalni ravni se bo zagotavljalo lokacijsko dostopnost in omogočalo (po potrebi dodatno spodbujalo), da posameznik na vadbo prihaja peš, s kolesom ali javnim transportom. S tem se bo dodatno vplivalo na zmanjševanje zdravju škodljivega vedenja ter zmanjševanje tveganj za zdravje, ki izhajajo iz onesnaževanja.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije se bodo izvajali programi socialne aktivacije+, ki bodo s svojim celostnim pristopom prispevali k izboljšanju socialne vključenosti oseb iz ciljne skupine in k povečanju njihovih zaposlitvenih možnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Medical equipment for hospitals
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Medicinska oprema za bolnišnice
Category_Label: Health equipment
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the operation is to provide public health institutions founded by the Republic of Slovenia with appropriate medical equipment that will ensure faster access to diagnostic and therapeutic services, which will also enable active monitoring of patients after illness. The equipment supplied will be intended for the management of conditions in hospitals, which will also enable higher-quality and faster medical treatment. The operation in question will make it possible to replace existing worn-out and obsolete medical equipment and to purchase new medical equipment for which hospitals have approved additional programmes. The objectives pursued by the implementation of the intended operation are to modernise the equipment and methods of diagnosis, to ensure the efficient and as smooth as possible operation of medical care, to ensure quality services, safety, accessibility and equal opportunities for treatment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije je zagotoviti javnim zdravstvenim zavodom, katerih ustanovitelj je Republika Slovenija, ustrezno medicinsko opremo, ki bo zagotovila hitrejši dostop do diagnostičnih in terapevtskih storitev, s katero bo obenem omogočeno tudi aktivno spremljanje bolnikov po obolelosti. Dobavljena oprema bo namenjena obvladovanju bolezenskih stanj v bolnišnicah, kar bo omogočilo tudi kakovostnejšo in hitrejšo zdravstveno obravnavo. S predmetno operacijo bo omogočeno nadomestiti obstoječo iztrošeno in zastarelo ter nabaviti novo medicinsko opremo, za katero imajo bolnišnice odobrene dodatne programe. Cilji, ki jih zasleduje izvedba predvidene operacije so modernizirati opremo in načine diagnostike, zagotoviti učinkovito in čim bolj nemoteno delovanje zdravstvene oskrbe, zagotoviti kvalitetne storitve, varnost, dostopnost ter enake možnosti za zdravljenje.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of digital solutions and modern technologies to promote sustainable mobility in the Municipality of Kranj
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvajanje digitalnih rešitev in sodobnih tehnologij za spodbujanje trajnostne mobilnosti v Mestni občini Kranj
Category_Label: Digitalisation of urban transport
Operation_Summary_English: The project is one of the investments that contribute to the sustainable development of society, well-being and quality of life of citizens and visitors. It represents an investment in information and communication technology in the field of sustainable mobility. The planned investment includes the use of modern technologies and digital solutions to establish urban traffic optimisation systems and support multimodal routes with sustainable forms of mobility and will enable: ? support for the use of PPPs (including systems for monitoring the number of passengers on vehicles), ? easy and user-friendly switching between different forms of mobility, ? implementation of sustainable parking policy measures, ? limitation of motor traffic in urban centres, friendly transport areas and zero-emission zones. The main part of the investment will be the establishment of a vertical to promote sustainable mobility, which will be part of the comprehensive digital platform Smart Kranj. The deployment of a technologically advanced Smart Cities Platform will contribute to the digitalisation, promotion and optimisation of sustainable mobility. In order to create a comprehensive and connected network of information that will enable better management of mobility and urban systems in the municipality and change the habits of users, the implementation of relevant data sources will be key. In this way, the following data will be integrated into the digital platform in the field of sustainable mobility or transport: ? Integration of parking-related data sources ? Integration with bike rental and micromobility systems? Integration of cycling and walking path data, traffic meters ? Integration of resources related to public passenger transport ? Integration with CeKR prepaid city card. As part of the project, the existing database of parking spaces and car parks in the area of Kranj will be upgraded so that they can be transmitted to the public platform SIPARK, established by the Ministry of the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy (hereinafter: MOPE), which enables the unified and standardised collection, editing and transmission of standardised static and dynamic data on publicly accessible parking spaces and car parks in Slovenia. In addition to the above activities, the following will be part of the project: ? upgrade of support for the use of public passenger transport (including systems for monitoring the number of passengers on vehicles), ? development, integration and upgrade of the system of online payments and e-commerce in the SMK - CeKR city card system (e-treasury and e-marketplace), ? studies and documentation produced necessary for the pilot establishment of a zero-emission zone, ? production of an update of the digital development and transition strategy of the IOC 2023-2029, ? upgrade of the accessibility map of Kranj for people with physical and sensory disabilities and its integration into the digital platform, ? establishment of a digital mobility map. It will also be necessary to purchase smaller hardware such as special paper tablets (reMarkable) with a pen (Marker plus) and a cover, as well as two laptops. It will also be necessary to hire and implement all IT equipment (hardware and software) for performing urban passenger transport and monitoring and obtaining data on transports and routes. A developed digital platform with these integrations will only be able to contribute to the promotion of sustainable mobility if it is actually used by IOC citizens. Therefore, information and publicity activities are also foreseen, which will include continuous campaigns, workshops, encouragement and participation of citizens/users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt spada med investicije, ki prispevajo k trajnostnemu razvoju družbe, blaginji in kakovosti življenja občanov in obiskovalcev. Predstavlja investiranje v informacijsko – komunikacijsko tehnologijo na področju trajnostne mobilnosti. Načrtovana investicija vključuje uporabo sodobnih tehnologij in digitalnih rešitev za vzpostavitev sistemov optimizacije prometa v mestih ter podporo večmodalnim potem s trajnostnimi oblikami mobilnosti in bo omogočala: ? podporo rabi JPP (vključno s sistemi spremljanja števila potnikov na vozilih), ? enostavno in uporabniku prijazno prehajanje med različnimi oblikami mobilnosti, ? izvajanje ukrepov trajnostne parkirne politike, ? omejevanje motornega prometa v mestnih jedrih, območjih prijaznega prometa in brezemisijskih conah. Večji del investicije bo predstavljala vzpostavitev vertikale za spodbujanje trajnostne mobilnosti, ki bo del celovite digitalne platforme Pametni Kranj. Uvedba tehnološko napredne platforme za pametna mesta bo prispevala k digitalizaciji, spodbujanju in optimizaciji trajnostne mobilnosti. Za ustvarjanje celovite in povezane mreže informacij, ki bo omogočala boljše upravljanje mobilnosti in urbanih sistemov v občini ter spremembo navad uporabnikov, bo ključna implementacija relevantnih podatkovnih virov. Tako bo v digitalno platformo na področju trajnostne mobilnosti oziroma prometa izvedena integracija naslednjih podatkov: ? Integracija podatkovnih virov, povezanih s parkirišči ? Integracija s sistemi izposoje koles in mikromobilnosti ? Integracija podatkov o kolesarskih in peš poteh, števci prometa ? Integracija virov, povezanih z javnim potniškim prometom ? Integracija s predplačniško mestno kartico CeKR. Obstoječo bazo podatkov o parkirnih mestih in parkiriščih na območju mesta Kranj se bo v sklopu projekta nadgradilo tako, da jih bo možno posredovati v javno platformo SIPARK, ki jo je vzpostavilo Ministrstvo za okolje, prostor in energijo (v nadaljevanju MOPE) in ki omogoča poenoteno in standardizirano zbiranje, urejanje in posredovanje standardiziranih statičnih in dinamičnih podatkov o javno dostopnih parkirnih mestih in parkiriščih v Sloveniji. Poleg predhodno navedenih aktivnosti bodo del projekta še: ? nadgradnja podpore uporabe javnega potniškega prometa (vključno s sistemi spremljanja števila potnikov na vozilih), ? razvoj, integracija ter nadgradnja sistema spletnih plačil ter e-trgovine v SMK – Sistem mestne kartice CeKR (e-blagajna in e-tržnica), ? izdelane študije in dokumentacija, potrebne za pilotno vzpostavitev brezemisijske cone, ? izdelava novelacije strategije digitalnega razvoja in prehoda MOK 2023-2029, ? nadgradnja zemljevida dostopnosti Kranja za gibalno in senzorično ovirane ter njena integracija v digitalno platformo, ? vzpostavitev digitalnega zemljevida hodljivosti. Potrebno bo kupiti tudi manjšo strojno opremo kot so posebne papirnate tablice (reMarkable) s pisalom (Marker plus) in ovitkom ter dva prenosnika. Prav tako bo potrebno najeti in implementirati celotno IT opremo (strojno in programsko) za izvajanje mestnega potniškega prometa ter spremljanje in pridobivanje podatkov o prevozih in linijah. Razvita digitalna platforma z navedenimi integracijami bo lahko prispevala k spodbujanju trajnostne mobilnosti le, če jo bodo občani in občanke MOK dejansko uporabljali. Zato so predvidene tudi aktivnosti informiranja in obveščanja javnosti, ki bodo vključevale kontinuirane kampanje, delavnice, spodbujanje in participacije občanov/uporabnikov

Operation_Name_English: Social inclusion of persons with disabilities in sport 2024 – 2028
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socialna vključenost invalidov na področju športa v obdobju 2024 – 2028
Category_Label: Promoting social integration of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion, including the most deprived and children
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Actively Inclusive" represents the operationalization of the measure of social inclusion of persons with special needs in the field of sport of persons with disabilities and is a program that follows the guidelines and goals at the national as well as international level for better social inclusion of persons with disabilities in sport and society, integration of sport of persons with disabilities into programs and organization of sport at the national, regional and local level. The "Actively Inclusive" programme will last 60 months, which is a sufficient period to fully support the development of sport for people with disabilities and a network of organisations, experts and programmes aimed at people with disabilities. The programme will be implemented by the consortium partners Association for Sport of the Disabled of Slovenia - Slovenian Paralympic Committee and Olympic Committee of Slovenia - Association of Sports Federations. Through the program "Actively Inclusive", they will train and up-skill professional staff for work in the field of sports for people with disabilities. An important part of the programme is also the purchase of special equipment necessary for the implementation of sports programmes for people with disabilities. It is also planned to purchase a vans for the transport of equipment, persons and will also be adapted for the transport of disabled people in wheelchairs. Among the important tasks will be the establishment of a new ABC program for the practice of sports for people with disabilities, which can be carried out in the local environment through sports organizations, disability organizations or individuals. As part of the programme, the implementation of ABC programmes by regional centres and regional coordinators is planned (it is planned to establish up to 12 regional centres during the duration of the operation). The new ABC sports training programme for people with disabilities will be universally designed. It will provide initial training opportunities and will be adapted to individual abilities. It will also be adapted to different types of disability and physical or other limitations. It will also be adapted to different age groups that will start exercising. The ABC programme of sports for people with disabilities will be prepared by a designated expert group, which will monitor the substantive implementation of the programme, the achievement of the planned results and confirm the priority sectors and contents. A large part of the programme consists of two strands dedicated to the implementation of the ABC programme of sport for persons with disabilities and the sectoral programmes of sport for persons with disabilities, through which the main indicators of the programme and operation are to be achieved. Each training program will last 60 hours, it can last a longer period of time, since there is a possibility of interruption due to the specifics of injuries or rehabilitation. A network of regular exercise providers for different target groups of persons with disabilities will be established. Regional dispersion of training programmes and reduction of mobility-related problems will be ensured. A new comprehensive programme of ABC sports training for people with disabilities and a list of qualified or educated personnel for work in the field of sports for people with disabilities will be established.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt »Aktivno inkluzivno« predstavlja operacionalizacijo ukrepa socialnega vključevanja oseb s posebnimi potrebami na področju športa invalidov in je program, ki sledi smernicam in ciljem na nacionalni, kot tudi mednarodni ravni za boljšo socialno vključenost invalidov v šport in družbo, integracijo športa invalidov v programe in organiziranost športa na nacionalni, regionalni in lokalni ravni. Program »Aktivno inkluzivno« bo trajal 60 mesecev, kar je zadostno obdobje za celovito podporo razvoju športa invalidov in mreže organizacij, strokovnjakov in programov, ki so namenjeni invalidom. Program bosta izvajala konzorcijska partnerja Zveza za šport invalidov Slovenije – Slovenski paralimpijski komite in Olimpijski komite Slovenije – Združenje športnih zvez. Preko programa »Aktivno inkluzivno« se bodo usposobili in do-usposobili strokovni kadri za delo na področju športa invalidov. Pomemben del programa je tudi nakup specialne opreme, ki je potrebna za izvajanje programov športa invalidov. Prav tako se načrtuje nakup kombiniranega vozila za transport opreme, oseb in bo prilagojeno tudi za transport invalidov na invalidskih vozičkih. Med pomembnimi nalogami bo vzpostavitev novega programa ABC vadba športa invalidov, ki se bo lahko izvajal v lokalnem okolju preko športnih organizacij, invalidskih organizacij ali posameznikov. V sklopu programa je načrtovana izvedba ABC programov s strani regijskih centrov in regijskih koordinatorjev (načrtovano je, da se tekom trajanja operacije vzpostavi do 12 regijskih centrov). Novi vadbeni program ABC športa invalidov bo univerzalno zastavljen. Omogočal bo začetne možnosti izvajanja vadbe in bo prilagojen zmožnostim posameznikov. Prilagojen bo tudi različnim vrstam invalidnosti in gibalnim ali drugim omejitvam. Prav tako bo prilagojen različnim starostnim skupinam, ki bodo pričele z vadbo. Program ABC športa invalidov bo pripravila imenovana ekspertna skupina, ki bo spremljala vsebinsko izvajanje programa, doseganje načrtovanih rezultatov ter potrjevala prednostne panoge in vsebine. Velik del programa predstavljata sklopa, ki sta namenjena izvajanju programa ABC športa invalidov in panožnih programov športa invalidov, preko katerih se želi doseči glavne kazalnike programa in operacije. Posamezni vadbeni program bo trajal 60 ur, lahko bo trajal daljše časovno obdobje, saj je možnost prekinitve zaradi specifike poškodb ali rehabilitacije. Vzpostavila se bo mreža ponudnikov redne vadbe za različne ciljne skupine invalidov. Zagotovila se bo regijska razpršenost vadbenih programov in zmanjševanje težav povezanih z mobilnostjo. Vzpostavljen bo nov celoviti program ABC vadbe športa invalidov in seznam usposobljenih oziroma izobraženih kadrov za delo na področju športa invalidov.

Operation_Name_English: eProcurement system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sistem e-javnega naročanja
Category_Label: Government ICT solutions, e-services, applications
Operation_Summary_English: The main purpose is to upgrade existing and introduce new public digital services, which will be simple, accessible, widely used and which will allow users to better plan and carry out the necessary steps in the implementation of the procurement procedure. This situation can be established through system upgrades, which must also include changes and additions to the outside world (other systems with which the e-JN system connects and exchanges data). The activities carried out during the implementation of the operation will significantly facilitate the use of the e-JN system by both contracting authorities and economic operators acting as tenderers in public procurement procedures. All the activities carried out will thus have a key impact on simplifying the implementation of public procurement procedures by contracting authorities, simplifying the participation of tenderers in procedures, increasing competitiveness, saving time in the implementation of procedures, reducing costs and administrative obstacles, and will also result in greater transparency and trust in the functioning of the public procurement system in the Republic of Slovenia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni namen je nadgraditi obstoječe in vpeljati nove javne digitalne storitve, ki bodo enostavne, dostopne, široko uporabljene in ki bodo uporabnikom omogočale boljše načrtovanje in izvedbo potrebnih korakov pri izvedbi postopka javnega naročanja. Navedeno stanje bo lahko vzpostavljeno z nadgradnjami sistema, ki morajo zajemati tudi spremembe in dopolnitve z zunanjim svetom (drugimi sistemi s katerimi se sistem e-JN povezuje in izmenjuje podatke). Aktivnosti, ki bodo izvedene tekom izvajanja operacije, bodo bistveno olajšale uporabo sistema e-JN tako naročnikom kot tudi gospodarskim subjektom, ki v postopkih javnega naročanja nastopajo v vlogi ponudnikov. Vse izvedene aktivnosti bodo tako ključno vplivale na poenostavitev izvajanja postopkov javnega naročanja pri naročnikih, poenostavitev sodelovanja ponudnikov v postopkih, prinesle povečanje konkurenčnosti, prihranek časa pri izvedbi postopkov, zniževanje stroškov in administrativnih ovir in imele za posledico tudi večjo transparentnost in zaupanje v delovanje sistema javnega naročanja v Republiki Sloveniji.

Operation_Name_English: nRF Module
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: nRF Modul
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: nRF Module is an innovative product intended for companies and individuals in the development of IoT devices. It is an electronic pad with a microcontroller that supports Bluetooth, a module for 4G data transfer over a mobile network and GPS positioning, while also providing WiFi connectivity. As the central core of any IoT device, it enables connection to sensors and data transfer to the server.nRF Module, solves the problems of small and medium-sized enterprises that develop high-tech products in their field, and do not have such development departments or are without highly specialized specialists in engineering fields. In addition to the physical product, they will also sell a license to customers. The license relates to the disclosure of electronic circuit design, firmware and basic support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: nRF Modul je inovativni produkt, namenjen podjetjem in posameznikom v razvoju IoT naprav. Predstavlja elektronsko ploščico z mikrokontrolerjem, ki podpira Bluetooth, modul za 4G prenos podatkov preko mobilnega omrežja in GPS pozicioniranje, obenem pa omogoča še WiFi povezljivost. Kot osrednje jedro vsake IoT naprave omogoča povezavo s senzorji in prenos podatkov na strežnik.nRF Modul, rešuje težave manjših in srednjih podjetij, ki razvijajo visokotehnološke proizvode na svojem področju, in nimajo tovrstnih razvojnih oddelkov oziroma so brez visoko specializiranih strokovnjakov na inženirskih področij. Poleg fizičnega produkta bodo strankam prodajali tudi licenco. Licenca se nanaša na razkritje načrta elektronskega vezja, programske opreme (firmware) in osnovno podporo.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a sports park Savsko naselje
