Operation_Name_English: Elixir: A breakthrough plasma solution for sustainable agriculture
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Elixir: Prebojna plazemska rešitev za trajnostno kmetijstvo
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the operation is the development of a sustainable alternative to artificial fertilizers; reducing the environmental impact of agriculture; facilitating access to fertilisers in remote regions; increase in yield without the use of chemicals. Elixir is a breakthrough plasma solution for sustainable agriculture. The key competitive advantage derives from the controlled formation of "artificial lightning" with high voltage and direct contact with water, which allows the effective binding of nitrogen and oxygen from the air into the aqueous solution. According to the market review, this is a unique solution, since most of the existing approaches rely on energy-intensive industrial synthesis of nitrogen compounds, which then require complex transport to farms.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet operacije je razvoj trajnostne alternative umetnim gnojilom; zmanjšanje vpliva kmetijstva na okolje; omogočanje dostopa do gnojil v odročnih regijah; povečanje pridelka brez uporabe kemikalij. Elixir je prebojna plazemska rešitev za trajnostno kmetijstvo. Ključna konkurenčna prednost izhaja iz nadzorovane tvorbe »umetnih strel« z visoko napetostjo in neposrednim stikom z vodo, kar omogoča učinkovito vezavo dušika in kisika iz zraka v vodno raztopino. Po pregledu trga gre za unikatno rešitev, saj večina obstoječih pristopov stavi na energijsko intenzivno industrijsko sintezo dušikovih spojin, ki nato zahtevajo kompleksen transport do kmetij.

Operation_Name_English: Sport park Slovenj Gradec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ureditev športnega parka Slovenj Gradec
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the investment is the arrangement of the Slovenj Gradec Sports Park. This ensures a more efficient use of the existing space in the urban area and the exploitation of its internal potentials. The project is aimed at the renovation and revitalization of already built-up areas and pursues the goal of establishing a modern, green and sustainably designed urban environment. The less used area is being revitalized, which is being transformed into a functional public space with new plantings, well-maintained sports and recreation areas and spaces for socializing and relaxation. Particular emphasis is placed on social inclusion and ensuring accessibility for all residents, including vulnerable groups. This strengthens community cohesion, promotes healthy lifestyles and sustainable mobility. At the same time, the investment strengthens the economic development of the city, as improved infrastructure attracts recreational tourism and opens up new opportunities for the local economy. It thus makes an important contribution to the overall regeneration of the urban area and increases the quality of life of all inhabitants. The project will enable the revitalization of 6,996 m2 of renovated and previously underutilized land.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet investicije je ureditev Športnega parka Slovenj Gradec. Na ta način se zagotavlja učinkovitejša raba obstoječega prostora v mestnem območju in izkoriščanje njegovih notranjih potencialov. Projekt je usmerjen v prenovo in oživitev že pozidanih površin ter sledi cilju vzpostavitve sodobnega, zelenega in trajnostno zasnovanega urbanega okolja. Revitalizira se manj izkoriščeno območje, ki se preoblikuje v funkcionalen javni prostor z novimi zasaditvami, urejenimi športno-rekreacijskimi površinami ter prostori za druženje in sprostitev. Poseben poudarek je na socialni vključenosti in zagotavljanju dostopnosti za vse prebivalce, vključno z ranljivimi skupinami. S tem se krepi skupnostna povezanost, spodbuja zdrav življenjski slog in trajnostna mobilnost. Naložba hkrati krepi gospodarski razvoj mesta, saj izboljšana infrastruktura privlači rekreacijski turizem in odpira nove priložnosti za lokalno gospodarstvo. Tako pomembno prispeva k celoviti prenovi urbanega območja in povišuje kakovost življenja vseh prebivalcev. Projekt bo omogočil revitalizacijo 6.996 m2 prenovljenih in doslej slabo izkoriščenih površin.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vzpostavitev in delovanje Stičišča za oblikovanje politik (SOP)
Category_Label: Support to environmentally-friendly production processes and resource efficiency in SMEs
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the SOP is to enable the development of comprehensive solutions through participatory experimentation in the field of policies and measures of pilot innovation in the public sector, thus supporting decision-making processes. Within the framework of the programme, we would like to: - to create a “laboratory” environment in which policy makers and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds (NGOs, citizens’ groups, professional organisations, universities and research centres, and businesses) work together to design, prototype and test innovative policies, regulations and public services to promote the transition to a circular and low-carbon economy and society; - build institutional capacity for participatory experimentation and innovation in the public sector; - monitor and measure the impact of implemented measures using appropriate research and analytics methods to better understand the situation and the visibility of changes (e.g. indices).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen SOP-a je omogočiti razvoj celovitih rešitev preko participativnega eksperimentiranja na področju politik in ukrepov pilotnega inoviranja v javnem sektorju in tako podpreti procese odločanja. V okviru programa želimo: - ustvariti “laboratorijsko” okolje v katerem bodo pripravljavci politik in deležniki raznolikih ozadij (NVO, skupine državljanov, strokovne organizacije, univerze in raziskovalni centri ter podjetja) v sodelovanju oblikovali, prototipirali in testirali inovativne politike, predpise in javne storitve za spodbujanje prehoda v krožno in nizkoogljično gospodarstvo in družbo; - graditi institucionalne zmogljivosti za participativno eksperimentiranje in inoviranje v javnem sektorju; - spremljati in meriti vpliv izvedenih ukrepov z ustreznimi metodami raziskovanja in analitike za boljše razumevanje stanja in vidnost sprememb (npr. indeksi).

Operation_Name_English: Noršinska ulica 1st phase
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Noršinska ulica 1. faza
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the operation "Noršinska ulica 1st phase", the 1st phase of the reconstruction of the local road Noršinska ulica in the length of 988 m, the existing width of 5.0 to 5.5 m. A new construction of a one-sided bidirectional cycling path in the length of 1.145 m is planned (of which 157 m in the area of the future bypass road and 988 m outside the area of the future bypass road), namely on the section from the Murska Sobota School of Economics to the intersection Noršinci - Rakičan. The section of the road with the planned new cycle path connects the town of Murska Sobota, especially the northern commercial and industrial part, with the settlements of Noršinci and Rakičan and other settlements in and outside the municipality. Main features of the operation: • arrangement of a single-sided bi-directional cycling path in the length of 1,145 m; • reconstruction of the local road LC 269 070-1 in the length of 988 m; • arrangement of the crossing of the local road LC 269 070-1 (for the settlement Rakičan); • protection or relocation of municipal and energy lines; • reconstruction of the bridge; • arrangement of drainage; • installation of a green buffer zone between the road and the cycling path; • traffic arrangement. The purpose of the operation is to contribute to the development of sustainable mobility in the Municipality of Murska Sobota and to encourage as much as possible an increase in the share of sustainable transport modes in the structure of daily mobility of the population. At the same time, the purpose of the operation is to provide basic infrastructural conditions for better connection of urban areas with the hinterland, increase traffic safety for the weakest road users and improve the quality of living space, and consequently influence the improvement of air quality and the reduction of noise.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije »Noršinska ulica 1. faza« je načrtovana 1. faza rekonstrukcije lokalne ceste Noršinske ulice v dolžini 988 m, obstoječe širine 5,0 do 5,5 m. Načrtovana je novogradnja enostranske dvosmerne kolesarske steze v dolžini 1.145 m (od tega 157 m v območju bodoče obvozne ceste in 988 m izven območja bodoče obvozne ceste), in sicer na odseku od Ekonomske šole Murska Sobota do križišča Noršinci – Rakičan. Predmetni odsek ceste z načrtovano novo kolesarsko stezo, povezuje mesto Murska Sobota, predvsem severni trgovski in industrijski del, z naselji Noršinci in Rakičan ter ostalimi naselji v in izven občine. Poglavitne značilnosti operacije: • ureditev enostranske dvosmerne kolesarske steze v dolžini 1.145 m, • rekonstrukcija lokalne ceste LC 269 070-1 v dolžini 988 m, • ureditev križišča lokalne ceste LC 269 070-1 (za naselje Rakičan), • zaščita oz. prestavitev komunalnih in energetskih vodov, • rekonstrukcija mostu, • ureditev odvodnjavanja, • umestitev zelenega varovalnega pasu med cesto in kolesarsko stezo, • prometna ureditev. Namen operacije je prispevati k razvoju trajnostne mobilnosti v Mestni občini Murska Sobota ter v največji možni meri spodbuditi dvig deleža trajnostnih prometnih načinov v strukturi dnevne mobilnosti prebivalstva. Hkrati je namen operacije zagotavljati osnovne infrastrukturne pogoje za boljšo povezanost urbanih območij z zaledjem, povečanje prometne varnosti za najšibkejše udeležence v prometu in izboljšanje kakovosti življenjskega prostora ter posledično vplivati na izboljšanje kakovosti zraka in zmanjšanje hrupa.

Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The project concerns the development of a smart chamber for the thermal treatment of foodstuffs with an automatic cooling system - TERMISS. The advantages of a smart chamber are: smart automation (two processes - thermal treatment and cooling, in one); IoT connected central control system over thermal food processing and smart cooling system; digitalized system for HACCP control of critical points in the food processing process (80% less electricity consumption).

Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurial over challenges - PONI Gorenjska
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive - PONI Gorenjska
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Gorenjska is part of the comprehensive PONI project, which is carried out throughout Slovenia. The purpose of the PONI Gorenjska operation is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Gorenjska region . It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Gorenjska je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Gorenjska je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Gorenjski regiji . Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj kulturno kreativnega sektorja (KKS) – PLATFORMA

Operation_Summary_English: The “National Platform - Centre for Creativity” (CzK) will take care of the upgrading and implementation of measures for the development of the cultural and creative sector in Slovenia and its integration with other sectors, for the development of technological and non-technological innovations, and contribute to the empowerment of the CCC and to decentralisation and internationalisation. The national platform CzK assumes the official role of the umbrella national coordinator of the cultural and creative sector in the Republic of Slovenia and the national entry point for connecting with this sector. Through its programmes, it establishes a quality, efficient and innovative environment for working in the field of CCC and its integration with other sectors. With its programmes and projects, it focuses on breakthrough projects, close substantive collaborations, selected topics and focus areas of the CCT, which strengthen: national cooperation in the CCC and cross-sectoral cooperation with the SIO and other sectors, internationalisation, international cooperation, professionalisation of the sector and its sales channels, polycentric development of the CCC through the integration and operation of CzK 2.0 at regional and local level (cooperation with regions, municipalities) in order to support local creators, and strengthen the integration of the CCC into the development policies of the Republic of Slovenia. In striving for the sustainable development of our society, it ensures the spill-over of the effects of the CCC into other sectors and its integration into all spheres of social activity.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: “Nacionalna platforma – Center za kreativnost” (CzK) bo skrbela za nadgradnjo in uresničitev ukrepov za razvoj kulturnega in kreativnega sektorja v Sloveniji in njegovega povezovanja z drugimi sektorji, za razvoj tehnoloških in netehnoloških inovacij ter prispevala k opolnomočenju KKS ter decentralizaciji in internacionalizaciji. Nacionalna platforma CzK prevzema uradno vlogo krovnega nacionalnega koordinatorja kulturnega in kreativnega sektorja v RS in nacionalne vstopne točke za povezovanje s tem sektorjem. S svojimi programi vzpostavlja kakovostno, učinkovito in inovativno okolje za delovanje na področju KKS ter njegovega povezovanja z drugimi sektorji. S svojimi programi in projekti se fokusira na prebojne projekte, na tesna vsebinska sodelovanja, izbrane teme in fokusna področja KKS, ki krepijo: nacionalno sodelovanje v KKS in medsektorsko sodelovanje s SIO ter drugimi sektorji, internacionalizacijo, mednarodno sodelovanje, profesionalizacijo sektorja in njegovih prodajnih kanalov, policentrični razvoj KKS skozi povezovanje in delovanje CzK 2.0 na regionalni in lokalni ravni (sodelovanje z regijami, občinami) z namenom podpore lokalnim ustvarjalcem, ter krepijo vpetost KKS v razvojne politike Republike Slovenije. V prizadevanju za trajnostni razvoj naše družbe zagotavlja prelivanje učinkov KKS v druge sektorje ter njegovo vpenjanje v vse družbene sfere delovanja.

Operation_Name_English: ECOC GO!2025 - SUPER 8

Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The main purpose of the project is to establish a versatile urban space, a new community centre that will connect cultural and artistic contents with local gastronomy. The Super 8 will be a versatile space that will serve as a playful cultural venue, as well as a pleasant and lively gathering place for people of all generations in the border degraded area. The Super 8 offer will consist of a gourmet, experiential and educational set. The centre will include a flexible gourmet bistro, a bar, a gallery, a stage, a living room, a market and a cultural library (a library of printed, audio, video and other digital content). All structures will be modular and the centre will be open for co-creation. This will inject new cultural, creative and urban content into the border area for all generations of inhabitants in order to promote integrated and inclusive social, economic and environmental development and sustainable tourism in the urban area. The project will contribute 1,543 m2 of renovated free and underused areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osnovni namen projekta je vzpostavitev vsestranskega urbanega prostora, novega skupnostnega centra, ki bo povezoval kulturne in umetniške vsebine z lokalno gastronomijo. Super 8 bo vsestranski prostor, ki bo služil kot igrivo kulturno prizorišče ter tudi prijetno in živahno zbirališče za ljudi vseh generacij na obmejnem degradiranem območju. Ponudbo Super 8 bosta tvorila gurmanski ter doživljajski in izobraževalni sklop. Center bo vključeval prilagodljivi gurmanski bistro, bar, galerijo, oder, dnevno sobo, tržnico in kulturoteko (knjižnico tiskanih, avdio, video in drugih digitalnih vsebin). Vse strukture bodo modularne in center bo odprt za soustvarjanje. S tem se bo območju ob meji vlilo novih kulturnih, ustvarjalnih in urbanotvornih vsebin za vse generacije prebivalcev z namenom spodbujanja celostnega in vključujočega socialnega, gospodarskega in okoljskega razvoja ter trajnostnega turizma na mestnem območju. Projekt bo prispeval1.543 m2 prenovljenih prostih in slabo izkoriščenih površin.

Operation_Name_English: CTN Arrangement of the Barjanska cesta road from Ziherlova cesta to the connection to the southern motorway
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CTN Ureditev Barjanske ceste od Ziherlove ceste do priključka na južno avtocesto
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project envisages the reconstruction of the Barjanska cesta road in Ljubljana, more precisely the section between Ziherl Street in the north and the connection to the southern motorway in the south. In addition to the reconstruction of the road, the reconstruction of the existing meteor sewerage in the area and the expansion of the existing bridge over Mali Graben are also planned. The planned reconstruction of the Barjanska cesta road includes the narrowing of the city road with the inclusion of yellow lanes for urban public transport vehicles, an intermediate greenery, as well as a two-way bicycle path and a two-way pedestrian corridor. At the intersection of the Barjanska cesta road and the connection to the AC at P+R Barje, a new spiral roundabout is planned, which will increase the flow of the connection. Bus stops are provided on the carriageway. The reconstruction of the Barjanska cesta road with an appropriate arrangement of PPP connections, cycling and walking surfaces is therefore extremely important in ensuring connectivity according to the function of different areas of the city of Ljubljana and enables better sustainable mobility of infrastructure users, and in this way the City of Ljubljana will also make an important contribution to the development of sustainable mobility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt predvideva rekonstrukcijo Barjanske ceste v Ljubljani, natančneje odsek med Ziherlovo ulico na severu in priključkom na južno avtocesto na jugu. Poleg rekonstrukcije ceste je predvidena še obnova obstoječe meteorne kanalizacije na tem območju ter širitev obstoječega mostu čez Mali Graben. Predvidena rekonstrukcija Barjanske ceste vključuje zožitev mestne ceste z vključitvijo rumenih pasov za vozila mestnega javnega potniškega prometa, vmesno zelenico, ter dvosmerno kolesarsko stezo in dvosmerni hodnik za pešce. Na križišču Barjanske ceste in priključka na AC pri P+R Barje je predvideno novo spiralno krožišče, ki bo povečalo pretočnost priključka. Avtobusna postajališča so predvidena na vozišču. Rekonstrukcija Barjanske ceste s primerno ureditvijo JPP povezav, kolesarskih in peš površin je torej izrednega pomena pri zagotavljanju povezanosti po funkciji različnih območij mesta Ljubljane ter omogoča boljšo trajnostno mobilnost uporabnikov infrastrukture, MOL pa bo na ta način tudi pomembno prispevala k razvoju trajnostne mobilnosti.

Operation_Name_English: OC-HULL robot for deburring underwater parts of large ships
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OC-HULL robot za odstanjevanje obrasti podvodnega dela velikih ladij
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Oceanik Tech d.o.o. is developing an innovative autonomous OC-HULL hull cleaning robot, which enables shipowners to significantly reduce fuel consumption and eliminate the need for toxic anti-vegetative coatings. In doing so, the robot contributes to the protection of the marine ecosystem and lower costs for shipowners. The problem addressed is the large-scale biological growth on hulls, which increases fuel costs by up to 40%, while increasing the risk of transmission of alien marine species.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Podjetje Oceanik Tech d.o.o. razvija inovativen avtonomni robot OC-HULL za čiščenje ladijskih trupov, ki ladjarjem omogoča znatno zmanjšanje porabe goriva ter odpravo potrebe po toksičnih protivegetativnih premazih. S tem robot prispeva k varovanju morskega ekosistema in nižjim stroškom ladjarjev. Naslovljeni problem je obsežna biološka obrast na ladijskih trupih, zaradi katere se stroški za gorivo povišajo tudi do 40 %, obenem pa se poveča tveganje za prenos tujerodnih morskih vrst.

Operation_Name_English: Social activation "AS-Activate yourself!"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socialna aktivacija »AS-Aktiviraj Se!«
Category_Label: Pathways to integration and re-entry into employment for disadvantaged people
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the AS-Activate Se! project will be the implementation of quality social activation programmes, which will enable the empowerment and activation of individuals through mandatory contents determined by the call and newly developed activities adapted on the basis of past good practices and current needs of participants. We will implement an in-depth individualization based on an assessment of the needs of each individual participant. This will allow intervention strategies and support services to be adapted to the specific circumstances and needs of the individual, which we believe will increase the efficiency of the implementation of each programme. Our goal is to ensure that every person involved in the project receives a personalized treatment that not only addresses their current needs, but also encourages the development of long-term skills necessary for active participation in society. This will include individual learning and development plans drawn up in cooperation with the participants and will include objectives in the fields of education, employment and personal development. In addition, we will set up a support system that includes regular progress evaluations, mentoring and coaching, as well as providing information and links to multidisciplinary professionals such as social workers, career counsellors and psychologists. This support will be tailored to the individual, as we want to promote the autonomy of the participants, while at the same time providing them with the necessary assistance in overcoming the obstacles to successful reintegration into the local environment. As part of the implementation of the project, we will further build on existing cooperation with local and regional stakeholders, including educational institutions, municipalities, NGOs and multigenerational centres, as well as with labour market stakeholders such as businesses and social enterprises. This broad network of cooperation will ensure an integrated approach to the social inclusion of the target group through a wide range of lifelong learning activities, with a focus on tolerant and equal treatment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta AS-Aktiviraj Se! bo izvedba kakovostnih programov socialne aktivacije, ki bodo z obveznimi vsebinami, določenimi z razpisom, ter novo razvitimi aktivnostmi, prilagojenimi na podlagi preteklih dobrih praks in aktualnih potreb udeležencev, omogočili opolnomočenje in aktivacijo posameznikov. Implementirali bomo poglobljen individualiziran, ki bo temeljil na oceni potreb vsakega posameznega udeleženca. Tako bomo omogočili, da se intervencijske strategije in podporne storitve prilagodijo specifičnim okoliščinam in potrebam posameznika, s čimer menimo, da se bo povečala učinkovitost same izvedbe posameznega programa. Naš cilj je zagotoviti, da je vsaka oseba, vključena v projekt, deležna personalizirane obravnave, ki ne naslavlja samo njene trenutne potrebe, ampak tudi spodbuja razvoj dolgoročnih veščin potrebnih za aktivno udeležbo v družbi. To bo vključevalo individualne načrte učenja in razvoja, ki bodo sestavljeni v sodelovanju z udeleženci, ter bodo vključevali cilje na področju izobraževanja, zaposlitve in osebnega razvoja. Poleg tega bomo vzpostavili sistem podpore, ki bo vključeval redne evalvacije napredka, mentorstvo in coaching, ter nudenje informacij in povezav do multidisciplinarnih strokovnjakov, kot so socialni delavci, karierni svetovalci in psihologi. Ta podpora bo prilagojena posamezniku, saj želimo spodbujati samostojnost udeležencev, hkrati pa jim zagotoviti potrebno pomoč pri premagovanju ovir za uspešno reintegracijo v lokalno okolje. V okviru izvajanja projekta bomo še nadgradili obstoječa sodelovanja z lokalnimi in regionalnimi deležniki, vključno z izobraževalnimi ustanovami, občinami, nevladnimi organizacijami in večgeneracijskimi centri, pa tudi z deležniki na trgu dela, kot so podjetja in socialna podjetja. Ta široka mreža sodelovanja bo zagotovila celostni pristop k socialni vključenosti ciljne skupine skozi raznovrstne aktivnosti vseživljenjskega učenja, pri čemer bo v ospredju strmenje k strpni in enakopravni obravnavi.

Operation_Summary_English: The Digi-Academy project has developed eight comprehensive educational programmes that systematically cover all five key areas of digital competence according to DigComp 2.2. Operation_Summary_English: The main purpose of the programme "Small-value incentives through vouchers" is the continuation of the system of granting small-value incentives, which will allow SMEs significantly simplified access to co-financing, with the help of which they will strengthen their competitiveness and competences, also in accordance with good foreign practices. This will remove perceived barriers that risk SMEs lagging behind in growth and development compared to larger companies. Operation_Name_English: Digitalisation of the system of recording, storing and using data in long-term care and social care
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalizacija sistema zapisovanja, shranjevanja in uporabe podatkov v dolgotrajni oskrbi in socialnem varstvu
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the investment is to support the digitalisation of DO and SV in Slovenia and to establish content bases that will enable the development of IT solutions, which are one of the key conditions for the implementation of the Long-Term Care Act (hereinafter: ZDOsk-1). A special emphasis of the investment will be on content support in the development of an information system for entry points (hereinafter: VT) at social work centres (hereinafter: CSD) within a single information system. In Slovenia, DO and SV service providers (and other stakeholders) currently have different information systems that are not properly interconnected and coordinated. The purpose of the investment is to provide content support in upgrading these information systems so that they can be integrated into a single information system. The investment will also help to upgrade information systems for the efficient recording, storage, use and exchange of data by DO and SV service providers and contribute to the development of tools for direct work with people. IT systems will be in line with modern trends and standards in the field of SV, DO, community social work and deinstitutionalisation. At the same time, the investment will provide training so that key stakeholders can effectively use the new and upgraded IT systems. The objectives of the investment are: ? to provide substantive support for the establishment of the initial information system of the DO entry points and to provide training for the use of this IS for 100 employees at 16 social work centres; ? prepare an assessment of the state of digitalisation of DO and SV providers in Slovenia and prepare a research report; ? establish the content bases for the development of a single information system and prepare guidelines for the development of an information system for VT DO; support the upgrading of contractors’ IT systems by developing guidelines for integration into the single IT system; ? coordinate the development of new prototype solutions for contractors and develop guidelines for the implementation of prototype solutions; ? set up a data and analysis system for DO at the investor - Institute of the Republic of Slovenia for Social Protection (IRSSV). Within the investment, substantive guidelines for the development and testing of the information system and the monitoring of its introduction to the VT will be prepared, whereby the investor will primarily take care of the content coordination and ensure compliance with the content plans and functional requirements. The implementation of IT solutions and the coordination of their technical implementation are not the subject of an investment , but a separate project to be carried out by SMEs. Due to the importance of data support for complex processes and the management of the DO and SV system, special attention will be paid to the establishment of data and analysis databases for DO and SV at the IRSSV as an investor.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen investicije je vsebinska podpora digitalizaciji DO in SV v Sloveniji ter vzpostavitev vsebinskih podlag, ki bodo omogočile razvoj informacijskih rešitev, ki so eden izmed ključnih pogojev za izvajanje Zakona o dolgotrajni oskrbi (v nadaljevanju: ZDOsk-1). Poseben poudarek investicije bo vsebinska podpora pri razvoju informacijskega sistema za vstopne točke (v nadaljevanju: VT) na centrih za socialno delo (v nadaljevanju: CSD) v okviru enotnega informacijskega sistema. V Sloveniji imajo izvajalci storitev DO in SV (in drugi deležniki) trenutno različne informacijske sisteme, ki med seboj niso ustrezno povezani in usklajeni. Namen investicije je nuditi vsebinsko podporo pri nadgradnji teh informacijskih sistemov, da se bodo lahko povezali v enotni informacijski sistem. Investicija bo poleg tega pripomogla k nadgradnji informacijskih sistemov za učinkovito beleženje, shranjevanje, uporabo in izmenjavo podatkov pri izvajalcih storitev DO in SV ter prispevala k razvoju orodij za direktno delo z ljudmi. IT sistemi bodo v skladu z sodobnimi trendi in standardi na področju SV, DO, skupnostnega socialnega dela in deinstitucionalizacije. Hkrati bo investicija zagotovila izobraževanja, da bodo lahko ključni deležniki DO nove in nadgrajene informacijske sisteme učinkovito uporabljali. Cilji investicije so: ? nuditi vsebinsko podporo pri vzpostavitvi začetnega informacijskega sistema vstopnih točk DO ter zagotoviti izobraževanje za uporabo tega IS za 100 zaposlenih na 16 centrih za socialno delo; ? izdelati oceno stanja digitaliziranosti izvajalcev DO in SV v Sloveniji ter pripraviti raziskovalno poročilo; ? vzpostaviti vsebinske podlage za razvoj enotnega informacijskega sistema ter pripraviti smernice za razvoj informacijskega sistema za VT DO; ? vsebinsko podpreti nadgradnjo informacijskih sistemov izvajalcev s pripravo smernic za vključitev v enotni informacijski sistem; ? koordinirati razvoj novih prototipnih rešitev za izvajalce ter pripraviti smernice za vpeljavo prototipnih rešitev; ? vzpostaviti podatkovni in analitski sistem za DO pri investitorju – Inštitutu RS za socialno varstvo (IRSSV). Znotraj investicije bodo pripravljene vsebinske smernice za razvoj in testiranje informacijskega sistema ter spremljanje njegove uvedbe na VT, pri čemer bo investitor skrbel predvsem za vsebinsko koordinacijo ter zagotavljanje skladnosti z vsebinskimi načrti in funkcionalnimi zahtevami. Sama implementacija informacijskih rešitev ter koordinacija tehnične izvedbe le teh nista predmet investicije , ampak ločen projekt, ki ga bo izvajal MSP. Zaradi pomembnosti podatkovne podpore kompleksnim procesom in upravljanju sistema DO in SV bo posebna pozornost v investiciji namenjena vzpostavitvi podatkovnih in analitskih baz za DO in SV pri IRSSV kot investitorju.

Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurship over challenges in the Posavje region
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive v Posavski regiji
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The PONI Posavje operation is part of the comprehensive PONI project, which is carried out throughout Slovenia. The purpose of the PONI Posavje operation is the entrepreneurial training of people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Posavje region. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Posavje je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Posavje je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Posavski regiji. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_English: ProjectPlezanje d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ProjektPlezanje d.o.o.
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the submitted project, the company is developing a product called ProjectClimb, which will revive the climbing wall with the help of video projections on the wall, cameras and artificial intelligence. The product will simplify and upgrade climbing trainings. Coaches will no longer have to point the chopstick, use stickers, remember long sequences of movements and reinvent new directions every time. The trainer will be able to easily show the direction on the wall with the help of a mobile device. He will be able to quickly draw a new direction, or adjust the already existing one. Climbers will also be able to use the routes without a coach. The product will record the climber with a camera and thus enable the recording of statistics and the analysis of trainings. Artificial intelligence will allow us to make the system quickly responsive and easy to use.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V sklopu prijavljenega projekta podjetje razvija produkt z imenom ProjectClimb, ki bo s pomočjo video projekcij na steno, kamere in umetne inteligence oživil plezalno steno. Produkt bo poenostavil in nadgradil plezalne treninge. Trenerjem ne bo več treba kazati s palčko, uporabljati nalepk, ne bo si več treba zapomniti dolgih sekvenc gibov in vsakič na novo izumljati novih smeri. Trener bo lahko enostavno s pomočjo mobilne naprave prikazal smer na steni. Hitro bo lahko narisal novo smer, ali prilagodil že obstoječe. Plezalci pa bodo lahko smeri uporabljali tudi brez trenerja. Produkt bo plezalca snemal s kamero in tako omogočil beleženje statistike in analizo treningov. Umetna inteligenca nam bo omogočila, da bo sistem hitro odziven in enostaven za uporabo.

Sistem samodejno zaznava prazni prostor, izboljšuje varnost in zmanjšuje tveganja pri prevozu blaga.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova ceste CKŽ - G1 5
Category_Label: Clean urban transport infrastructure|Clean urban transport rolling stock|Alternative fuels infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The operation envisages the reconstruction of pedestrian areas on the section G1-5/0336 from km 1+111 (crossroad near the cemetery) to km 2+350 (to the connection at TC Krško), as well as the purchase of an electric bus and the installation of a charging station for PHP. As part of the reconstruction of the road and pedestrian areas, it is also provided for: renovation of bus stops, traffic lightization of the pedestrian crossing of the road, renovation of road lighting, protection and relocation of existing ducts of commercial public infrastructure (water supply, EE ducts, TK ducts, ŠOEK) and landscape architecture.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije je predvidena rekonstrukcija površin za pešce na odseku G1-5/0336 od km 1+111 (križišče pri pokopališču) do km 2+350 (do priključka pri TC Krško) ter nakup električnega avtobusa in postavitev polnilnice za JPP. V sklopu rekonstrukcije ceste in površin za pešce je predvideno tudi: obnova avtobusnih postajališč, semaforizacija peš prehoda ceste, obnova cestne razsvetljave, zaščita in prestavitev obstoječih vodov gospodarske javne infrastrukture (vodovod, EE vodi, TK vodi, ŠOEK) in krajinska arhitektura.

Operation_Name_English: Integrated treatment of people with chronic kidney disease from the perspective of strengthening health literacy and reducing health inequalities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Integrirana obravnava oseb s kronično ledvično boleznijo z vidika krepitve zdravstvene pismenosti in zmanjševanja neenakosti v zdravju
Category_Label: Measures to improve the accessibility, effectiveness and resilience of healthcare systems (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the direct confirmation of the operation is the co-financing of activities that will contribute to the development and implementation of interdisciplinary, preventive treatment for persons with chronic kidney disease (hereinafter: KLB) at the primary level of health care and to the development and implementation of an integrated pathway for the treatment of persons with KLB in Slovenia, from the point of view of improving health literacy and reducing health inequalities. The purpose of the direct confirmation of the operation is the development of a preventive programme for persons with KLB at the primary level, which will also enable the creation of an integrated treatment route for persons with KLB, which will connect structures and services in the health system (at different levels of health care) and beyond (non-governmental organisations, local groups for health promotion, local communities), which will contribute to better treatment and self-sufficiency of persons with KLB and ensure better accessibility and equal treatment of persons with KLB in Slovenia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet neposredne potrditve operacije je sofinanciranje aktivnosti, ki bodo prispevale k razvoju in implementaciji interdisciplinarne, preventivne obravnave za osebe s kronično ledvično boleznijo (v nadaljnjem besedilu: KLB) na primarni ravni zdravstvenega varstva ter k razvoju in implementaciji integrirane poti obravnave oseb s KLB v Sloveniji, z vidika izboljševanja zdravstvene pismenosti in zmanjševanja neenakosti v zdravju. Namen neposredne potrditve operacije je razvoj preventivnega programa za osebe s KLB na primarnem nivoju, ki bo omogočal tudi izdelavo integrirane poti obravnave oseb s KLB, ki bo povezala strukture in storitve v zdravstvenem sistemu (na različnih ravneh zdravstvenega varstva) in izven njega (nevladne organizacije, lokalne skupine za krepitev zdravja, lokalne skupnosti), kar bo prispevalo k boljši obravnavi ter samooskrbi oseb s KLB ter zagotavljanju boljše dostopnosti in enake obravnave oseb s KLB v Sloveniji.

Operation_Summary_English: As part of the submitted project, the company is developing a smart application WeFarm, which will encourage the maximum utilisation of arable land through digitalisation and the use of modern tools. Based on the location, weather, light and condition of the soil, the application will recommend the best plants, the optimal planting schedule and methods of care. Na podlagi lokacije, vremena, svetlobe in stanja tal bo aplikacija priporočala najboljše rastline, optimalen razpored zasaditve ter načine oskrbe. Uporabniki bodo lahko spremljali rast pridelka s fotografiranjem, UI pa bo analizirala njegovo zdravje in opozarjala na bolezni ali pomanjkanje hranil. Operation_Name_English: Renovation of Bloudek Park in Tivoli
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prenova Bloudkovega parka v Tivoliju
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project for the renovation of Bloudek Park in Tivoli envisages the renovation of the playground, which was originally erected in 1960. Today, the playground shows signs of wear and tear and the need for renovation. Although some elements of the original design are still present, they have faded due to repeated restoration. Key reasons for the renovation include the durability of existing elements, such as tunnel area, sandbox and safety substrates, which are in poor condition. The renovation will thus make it possible to restore and upgrade the gaming environment, restore safety standards, improve the route infrastructure and revive the original concept of the playground, which would contribute to a better quality of the game and the experience of visitors. The project to renovate Bloudek's playground will pay special attention to improving green infrastructure. The scope of the renovation covers the entire area of the park, and the renovation will include children's playground and natural elements, such as trunks, and horns. When renovating trees, the emphasis will be on preserving existing trees, and the playground area will be supplemented with new trees and shrubs, taking into account the need to strengthen biodiversity. The project will contribute 12,052.39 m2 of renovated outdoor areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt prenove Bloudkovega parka v Tivoliju predvideva prenovo igrišča, ki je bilo prvotno postavljeno leta 1960. Danes igrišče kaže znake obrabe in potrebe po prenovi. Čeprav so nekateri elementi prvotne zasnove še vedno prisotni, so zaradi večkratne obnove zbledeli. Ključni razlogi za prenovo vključujejo dotrajanost obstoječih elementov, kot so območje tunelov, peskovnik in varnostne podlage, ki so v slabem stanju. Prenova bo tako omogočila obnovo in nadgradnjo igralnega okolja, obnovitev varnostnih standardov, izboljšanje infrastrukture poti ter oživitev prvotnega koncepta igrišča, kar bi prispevalo k boljši kakovosti igre in izkušnji obiskovalcev. Projekt prenove Bloudkovega igrišča bo posebno pozornost namenila izboljšanju zelene infrastrukture. Obseg prenove zajema celotno območje parka, prenova pa bo vključevala otroška igrala in naravne elemente, kot so debla, in rogovile. Pri prenovi drevnine bo poudarek na ohranjanju obstoječih dreves, območje igrišča pa bo dopolnjeno z novo drevnino in grmovnicami, upoštevajoč potrebo po krepitvi biodiverzitete. Projekt bo prispeval 12.052,39 m2 prenovljenih zunanjih površin.

Operation_Summary_English: Implementation of the PPo model for planning, development, coordination, implementation and monitoring of the programme of first brokers (hereinafter: PPo) in the system of emergency medical assistance (hereinafter: NMP) is a necessary element for the professional implementation of a program designed to help patients who experience sudden cardiac arrest, stroke, foreign body obstruction in the upper respiratory tract or severe external bleeding. With the help of the project Implementation of the PPo model for the implementation of basic resuscitation procedures and the provision of assistance with other previously described emergency medical conditions, we will manage, establish and arrange the status of PPo, which aims to improve survival and outcome in patients with sudden cardiac arrest and other previously described emergency conditions.

Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the public call is the allocation of European cohesion policy funds to municipalities to co-finance the costs of the process of preparing the CIP, which is implemented as a non-infrastructure measure at horizontal level within the framework of the PEKP 21-27, priority 5 "Sustainable (cross-)regional mobility and connectivity", specific objective RSO 3.2 "Development and strengthening sustainable, climate-resilient, smart and intermodal national, regional and local mobility, including improved access to the TEN-T network and cross-border mobility". The purpose of the public tender is to establish sustainable transport planning in Slovenian municipalities through the preparation of a basic strategic document, i.e. the municipal integrated transport strategy (OCPS), as defined in Article 21 of the Integrated Transport Planning Act (Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia No 130/2022) and the Rules on the content, form, method of preparation, percentage and amount of co-financing of municipal integrated transport strategies, method of monitoring and criteria for quality assessment, uniform indicators, methodology and information support and reporting (Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia Nos 76/2023 and 109/2023). The aim of the call for proposals is to introduce and promote integrated transport planning and to direct local communities towards the development of sustainable transport by means of instruments such as OCPS, which will form the basis for the long-term and systematic implementation of measures to promote sustainable forms of mobility at local level.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet javnega razpisa je dodelitev sredstev evropske kohezijske politike občinam za sofinanciranje stroškov postopka priprave OCPS, ki se izvaja kot neinfrastrukturni ukrep na horizontalni ravni v okviru PEKP 21–27, prednostne naloge 5 »Trajnostna (čez)regionalna mobilnost in povezljivost«, specifičnega cilja RSO 3.2 »Razvoj in krepitev trajnostne, pametne in intermodalne nacionalne, regionalne in lokalne mobilnosti, odporne proti podnebnim spremembam, vključno z boljšim dostopom do omrežja TEN-T in čezmejno mobilnostjo«. Namen javnega razpisa je vzpostavitev trajnostnega načrtovanja prometa v slovenskih občinah s pomočjo izdelanega temeljnega strateškega dokumenta, tj. občinske celostne prometne strategije (OCPS), kot jo opredeljujeta 21. člen Zakona o celostnem prometnem načrtovanju (Uradni list RS, št. 130/2022) in Pravilnik o vsebini, obliki, načinu priprave, odstotku in višini sofinanciranja občinskih celostnih prometnih strategij, načinu spremljanja in merilih za presojo kakovosti, enotnih kazalnikih, metodologiji ter o informacijski podpori in poročanju (Uradni list RS, št. 76/2023 in 109/2023). Cilj javnega razpisa je vpeljava in spodbujanje celostnega prometnega načrtovanja ter usmerjanje lokalnih skupnosti v razvoj trajnostnega prometa s pomočjo instrumentov, kot je OCPS, ki bodo podlaga za dolgoročno in sistematično izvajanje ukrepov za spodbujanje trajnostnih oblik mobilnosti na lokalni ravni.

Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is 3DplusA, which is an innovative web service that enables automatic, fast, easy and efficient generation of photorealistic, high-detailed 3D models from videos. The company's goal is to become the world's leading company in the field of photorealistic, high-detailed 3D models with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation.

Cilj podjetja je postati vodilno svetovno podjetje na področju izdelave fotorealističnih, visoko detajlnih 3D-modelov z velikim poudarkom na trajnosti in inovativnosti.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Krepitev krožnega gospodarstva v regionalnih mrežah s problemskim učenjem študentov
Category_Label: Support for tertiary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The operation will enable the acquisition of practical experience, knowledge and competences of students in the work environment during their studies, encourage the strengthening of cooperation and integration and transfer of knowledge between the higher education system and the work environment (the economy and the non-economy and non-profit sector in the local and regional environment). In this way, young people will be able to develop their skills in the realization of ideas, the development of entrepreneurship, innovation, creative and critical thinking, creativity, etc. for greater employability and easier transition into the working environment after the completion of their studies. The call also addresses other challenges of higher education, such as the systemic introduction of knowledge transfer between higher education institutions and the working environment, greater flexibility and adaptation of study programmes to the needs of the labour market, and the establishment of long-term cooperation between higher education institutions and the working environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije bo omogočeno pridobivanje praktičnih izkušenj, znanj in kompetenc študentov v delovnem okolju v času študija, spodbujanje krepitve sodelovanja in povezovanja ter prenosa znanja med visokošolskim sistemom in med delovnim okoljem (gospodarstvo ter negospodarstvo in neprofitni sektor v lokalnem in regionalnem okolju). Na ta način se bo mladim omogočalo razvoj znanj in spretnosti pri uresničevanju idej, razvoj podjetnosti, inovativnosti, kreativnega in kritičnega razmišljanja, ustvarjalnosti ipd. za večjo zaposljivost in lažji prehod v delovno okolje po zaključku študija. Z javnim razpisom se naslavlja tudi druge izzive visokega šolstva kot npr. sistemsko uvajanje prenosa znanja med visokošolskimi zavodi in delovnim okoljem, večja fleksibilnost in prilagajanje študijskih programov potrebam trga dela ter vzpostavitev dolgoročnega sodelovanja med visokošolskimi zavodi in delovnim okoljem.

Operation_Name_English: Learning Workshops+
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Učne delavnice+
Category_Label: Pathways to integration and re-entry into employment for disadvantaged people
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Learning Workshop+ operation is the integration of vulnerable target groups into the social entrepreneurship environment and the development of activities and employment in existing social enterprises.Learning Workshops+ will thus significantly promote the social inclusion of people who need in-depth consideration, have identified multiple barriers to entering the labour market and are at risk of poverty or social exclusion. More specifically, the aim of the Learning Workshops+ operation is to promote, with the first sub-activity, the practical training of vulnerable unemployed persons who need in-depth consideration in the concrete working environment of social entrepreneurship and increase their social, professional and labour integration, competitiveness in the labour market and the acquisition and strengthening of their knowledge, skills and competences. In doing so, the operation contributes to the integration and empowerment of vulnerable social groups in order to put into practice the principle of equal opportunities and avoid slipping into social exclusion. At the same time, the operation with the second sub-activity represents active support in employment, as it encourages participants who complete practical training to participate in subsidised employment with all other employers, not only those from the social entrepreneurship environment, in the form of an employment relationship, whereby the ZRSZ pays employers a subsidy for employment. The programme contributes to tackling the social and labour exclusion of unemployed people with an individualised and mulitidisciplinary approach and with integrated psychosocial assistance to strengthen general competences. This also contributes to reducing the mismatch between supply and demand on the labour market and to increasing the social security coverage of the unemployed in the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije Učne delavnice+ je vključevanje ranljivih ciljnih skupin v okolje socialnega podjetništva in razvoj dejavnosti in zaposlovanja v obstoječih socialnih podjetjih.Učne delavnice+ bodo tako pomembno spodbujale socialno vključevanje oseb, ki potrebujejo poglobljeno obravnavo, imajo identificirane multiple ovire pri vstopanju na trg dela in so izpostavljene tveganju revščine ali socialne izključenosti. Konkretneje je namen operacije Učne delavnice+ s prvo podaktivnostjo spodbujati praktično usposabljanje ranljivih brezposelnih oseb, ki potrebujejo poglobljeno obravnavo v konkretnem delovnem okolju socialnega podjetništva in povečanje njihove socialne, poklicne in delovne integracije, konkurenčnosti na trgu dela ter pridobitev in krepitev njihovih, znanj, spretnosti in kompetenc. S tem operacija prispeva k integraciji in opolnomočenju ranljivih družbenih skupin za udejanjanje načela enakih možnosti in preprečevanje zdrsa v socialno izključenost. Hkrati operacija z drugo podaktivnostjo predstavlja aktivno podporo pri zaposlitvi, saj spodbuja udeležence, ki zaključijo praktično usposabljanje, da se v okviru operacije vključijo v subvencionirano zaposlitev pri vseh ostalih delodajalcih, ne le tistih iz okolja socialnega podjetništva in sicer v obliki delovnega razmerja pri čemer ZRSZ delodajalcem izplača subvencijo za zaposlitev. K reševanju socialne in delovne izključenosti brezposelnih oseb program prispeva z individualiziranim in mulitidisciplinarnim pristopom ter z vključeno psihosocialno pomočjo za krepitev splošnih kompetenc. Navedeno prispeva tudi k zmanjševanju neskladja med ponudbo in povpraševanjem na trgu dela ter povečanju socialne varnosti brezposelnih iz ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Information and alert system for citizens on ambient air pollution - Lastovka
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sistem seznanjanja in opozarjanja državljanov o onesnaženosti zunanjega zraka - Lastovka
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide comprehensive monitoring of the state of air pollution, prepare expert bases for decision-makers to plan and monitor the implementation of policies and measures to improve air quality in accordance with the requirements of the Slovenian and EU acquis, and warn citizens about ambient air pollution and inform them about the quality of precipitation. The project will expand the network of fixed measuring points for ambient air quality, establish automatic measurements of mercury, upgrade measurements for monitoring ambient air quality - carbon measurements, renew the network for monitoring precipitation quality, set up a mobile station and alert citizens about ambient air pollution on mobile devices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: S projektom se bo zagotovilo celovito spremljanje stanja onesnaženosti zraka, pripravile se bodo strokovne podlage odločevalcem za načrtovanje in spremljanje izvajanja politik in ukrepov za izboljšanje kakovosti zraka skladno z zahtevami pravnega reda RS in EU ter opozarjalo državljane glede onesnaženosti zunanjega zraka in seznanjalo s kakovostjo padavin. V okviru projekta se bo izvedla razširitev merilne mreže stalnih merilnih mest za kakovost zunanjega zraka, vzpostavitev avtomatskih meritev živega srebra, nadgradnja meritev za spremljanje kakovosti zunanjega zraka – meritve ogljika, prenova merilne mreže za spremljanje kakovosti padavin, vzpostavitev mobilne postaje ter opozarjanja državljanov glede onesnaženosti zunanjega zraka na mobilnih napravah.

Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurship over challenges in the region of South-East Slovenia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive v regiji JV Slovenija
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI JV Slovenia is part of the comprehensive project PONI, which is carried out on the entire territory of Slovenia. The purpose of the operation PONI JV Slovenia is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize the entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the region of JV Slovenia. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI JV Slovenija je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI JV Slovenija je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v regiji JV Slovenija. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_English: Development of work competences and specialised programmes for persons involved in probation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj delovnih kompetenc in specializiranih programov za osebe, vključene v probacijo
Category_Label: Promoting social integration of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion, including the most deprived and children
Operation_Summary_English: The operation envisages the development of four specialised programmes in probation, namely mentoring for persons performing work in the general interest, a programme for perpetrators of domestic violence, a programme for perpetrators of sexual offences and a programme for the development of social skills. In doing so, the operation follows key national and European orientations addressing the area of sanction enforcement in probation. The basic objective of the operation is to develop new programmes to address the specific needs of criminals, which in turn enables people to better reintegrate into society, better employment opportunities, greater empowerment and a higher quality of life, thus reducing the risk of repeat offences. 600 people involved in the probation will be included in the specialized programs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija predvideva razvoj štirih specializiranih programov v probaciji, in sicer mentorstvo za osebe, ki izvršujejo delo v splošno korist, program za storilce kaznivih dejanj nasilja v družini, program za storilce kaznivih dejanj zoper spolno nedotakljivost in program za razvijanje socialnih veščin. Pri tem operacija sledi ključnim nacionalnim in evropskim usmeritvam, ki obravnavajo področje izvrševanja sankcij v probaciji. Temeljni cilj operacije je razviti nove programe in s tem v obravnavo zajeti specifične potrebe storilcev kaznivih dejanj, to pa omogoča osebam lažjo reintegracijo v družbo, boljše zaposlitvene možnosti, večjo opolnomočenost in višjo kvaliteto življenja ter s tem zmanjšana tveganja za ponovitev kaznivih dejanj. V specializirane programe bo vključenih 600 oseb, ki so vključene v probacijo.

Operation_Name_English: Realtracing We trace real estate opportunities to boost your sales. We identify real estate opportunities to accelerate your sales
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Realtracing We trace real estate opportunities to boost your sales. Identificiramo nepremičninske priložnosti za pospeševanje vaše prodaje
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Realtracing is a software as a service (SAAS) and data solution that provides customers with an insight into the opportunities of the construction and real estate markets. Realtracing.com optimizes the work of commercialists. The Realtracing platform collects and transparently presents data on real estate transactions, active and future construction sites and related actors. This data is critical for providers of construction products and services, real estate agencies and investors and buyers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realtracing je SAAS (software as a service) in podatkovna rešitev, ki kupcem omogoča vpogled v priložnosti gradbenega in nepremičninskega trga. Realtracing.com optimizira delo komercialistov. S platformo Realtracing se zberejo in pregledno predstavijo podatki o nepremičninskih transakcijah, aktivnih in bodočih gradbiščih ter povezanih akterjih. Ti podatki so kritičnega pomena za ponudnike gradbenih produktov in storitev, nepremičninske agencije ter investitorje in kupce.

Operation_Name_English: Uroflowmeter - a device for measuring a stream of urine
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uroflowmeter - naprava za merjenje curka urina
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The operation includes the development of a device for measuring a jet of urine - Uroflowmeter under the IPeeWell brand, obtaining a certificate for a medical device for Slovenia and the EU in 2025, and the start of promotional activities and sales at the end of 2025. The device can even acquire 13 parameters of a stream of urine (intended for urologists; second only 5-6) and has an automatic interpretation of the results in an intelligible form (intended for users). Competitive devices do not have this. Urologists are allowed to compare several outcomes together. A urination diary is automatically kept, which urologists also need when making decisions. It is the first uroflow on the market with voice control, which is especially useful for older users. Basically working is the corresponding application solution for Android and Windows. This is followed by an application solution for IOS and a solution for measuring additional 7 parameters.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija obsega razvoj naprave za merjenje curka urina - Uroflowmeter pod blagovno znamko IPeeWell, pridobitev certifikata za medicinski pripomoček za Slovenijo in EU v letu 2025 ter začeteke promocijskih aktivnosti in prodaje konec 2025. Naprava lahko pridobi celo 13 parametrov curka urina (namenjeno urologom; drugi le 5-6) in ima avtomatsko interpretacijo rezultatov v razumljivi obliki (namenjeno uporabnikom). Tega konkurenčne naprave nimajo. Urologom je omogočena primerjava več izidov skupaj. Avtomatsko se vodi dnevnik uriniranja, ki ga urologi tudi potrebujemo pri odločitvah. Je prvi uroflow na trgu z možnostjo glasovnega upravljanja, kar je koristno predvsem za starejše uporabnike. Osnovno delujoča je pripadajoča aplikativna rešitev za Android in Windows. Sledi aplikativna rešitev za IOS in rešitev za meritve dodatnih 7 parametrov.

Operation_Name_English: Business zone Rudnik Hrastnik
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poslovna cona Rudnik Hrastnik
Category_Label: Business infrastructure for SMEs (including industrial parks and sites)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is functional development or revitalization of the business zone. The revitalization of the PC represents the construction of infrastructure in the Rudnik business zone on sanitary areas connected with coal mining and coal use in the Municipality of Hrastnik. The goal of the project is an innovative and competitive economy. The key objectives are a supportive environment and access to services for the economy, improving infrastructure for the needs of the economy and increasing the added value of economic activities. It will also meet the objective of a green and low-carbon economy to improve the quality of the environment. The implementation of the project will provide both existing and potential new companies with the appropriate infrastructure and favourable conditions for the implementation of their business activity. The further development of small and medium-sized enterprises, which are key drivers of economic development, will be encouraged. As part of the revitalization of the Rudnik Hrastnik Business Zone, a modern transport utility and other missing infrastructure will be established with the implementation of the project: construction of road infrastructure with public lighting (554.84 m), construction of meteor sewerage (480.49 m) and faecal sewerage (390.27 m), construction of water supply (832.85 m).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen projekta je funkcionalni razvoj oz. revitalizacija poslovne cone. Revitalizacija PC predstavlja izgradnjo infrastrukture v Poslovni coni Rudnik na sanitarnih površinah povezanih s premogovništvom in rabo premoga v Občini Hrastnik. Cilj projekta je inovativno in konkurenčno gospodarstvo. Ključni cilji so podporno okolje in dostopnost storitev za gospodarstvo, izboljšanje infrastrukture za potrebe gospodarstva ter povečanje dodatne vrednosti gospodarskih dejavnosti. Prav tako bo zadoščeno cilju za zeleno in nizkoogljično gospodarstvo za izboljšanje kakovosti okolja. Z izvedbo projekta se bo tako obstoječim kot morebitnim novim podjetjem zagotovilo ustrezno infrastrukturo in ugodne pogoje za izvajanje njihove poslovne dejavnosti. Spodbudil se bo nadaljnji razvoj malih in srednje velikih podjetij, ki so ključni nosilci gospodarskega razvoja. V okviru revitalizacije Poslovne cone Rudnik Hrastnik se bo z izvedbo projekta vzpostavila moderna prometna komunalna in druga manjkajoča infrastruktura: gradnja cestne infrastrukture z javno razsvetljavo (554,84 m), izgradnja meteorne kanalizacije (480,49 m) in fekalne kanalizacije (390,27 m), izgradnja vodovoda (832,85 m).

Operation_Name_English: ReVino
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ReVino
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: ReVino focuses on sustainably tackling the problem of excess wine-growing waste, such as grape marc, which represents an ecological and economic burden for winegrowers and the environment. They target winegrowers, the wine industry, plastic producers and sensitive consumers looking for environmentally friendly products. The innovation transforms this waste into high-quality bio-plastics that are used to make sustainable wine products and packaging.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: ReVino se osredotoča na trajnostno reševanje problema presežnih vinogradniških odpadkov, kot so grozdne tropine, ki predstavljajo ekološko in ekonomsko breme za vinogradnike in okolje. Ciljajo na vinogradnike, vinske industrije, proizvajalce plastike in občutljive potrošnike, ki iščejo okolju prijazne izdelke. Inovacija pretvarja te odpadke v visokokakovostno bio plastiko, ki jo uporabljajo za izdelavo trajnostnih vinarskih izdelkov in embalaže.

Operation_Name_English: Accessible long-term care – Improving access to services and information on long-term care
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dostopna dolgotrajna oskrba – Izboljšanje dostopnosti storitev in informiranje o dolgotrajni oskrbi
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the operation is to support the enforcement of the Long-Term Care Act (ZDOsk-1) and improve access to long-term care rights (DO). By carrying out promotional activities at national level and setting up a call centre, the operation will contribute to greater visibility of the DO system, better information to the general and professional public, and thus to a more efficient use of services. This will also allow for the effective exercise of the legally defined rights in practice. The operation is aimed at strengthening the personnel of the Ministry of the Solidarity Future (SME), which is responsible for regulating the long-term care system, enhanced communication on the rights and obligations of providers and beneficiaries of DOs provided by the law, and easier access to information on how the law is implemented. The beneficiary will be an SME (project unit in the Directorate in charge of long-term care). The objectives of the operation are: To improve the awareness and information of people, potential beneficiaries of DTC and the general public about long-term care in Slovenia and the possibilities of exercising the rights to DTC under ZDOsk-1 by carrying out an information campaign in the years 2025 to 2028. To sensitize the population to the needs of older people and people with disabilities by running a campaign from 2025 to 2028. Increase access to DOs and provide more information to interested potential beneficiaries of DOs, service users and other individuals in a direct and individualised way by setting up a call centre in the years 2025 to 2027. The activities of the operation/project are: I. Conducting, monitoring and directing the operation. II. Information to the public and promotion of long-term care at national level. III. Establishment of a call centre for direct information on long-term care.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen operacije je podpiranje uveljavljanja Zakona o dolgotrajni oskrbi (ZDOsk-1) ter izboljšanje dostopa do pravic iz naslova dolgotrajne oskrbe (DO). Z izvajanjem promocijskih aktivnosti na nacionalni ravni in vzpostavitvijo klicnega centra bo operacija prispevala k večji prepoznavnosti sistema DO, boljši obveščenosti splošne in strokovne javnosti ter s tem tudi k učinkovitejši uporabi storitev. Na ta način bo omogočeno tudi dejansko izvajanje zakonsko opredeljenih pravic v praksi. Operacija je namenjena kadrovski krepitvi Ministrstva za solidarno prihodnost (MSP), ki je pristojno za urejanje sistema dolgotrajne oskrbe, okrepljenemu komuniciranju o pravicah in obveznostih izvajalcev ter upravičencev do DO, ki jih prinaša zakon ter lažjemu dostopu do informacij o načinu izvajanja zakona. Upravičenec bo MSP (projektna enota na direktoratu, ki je pristojen za dolgotrajno oskrbo). Cilji operacije so: - Izboljšati ozaveščenost in obveščenost ljudi, potencialnih upravičencev do DO ter širše javnosti o dolgotrajni oskrbi v Sloveniji in možnostih uresničevanja pravic do DO po ZDOsk-1 z izvedbo kampanje za informiranje v letih od 2025 do 2028. - Senzibilizirati prebivalstvo za potrebe starejših ljudi in ljudi z ovirami z izvedbo kampanje v letih od 2025 do 2028. - Povečati dostop do DO in zagotovitev večje informiranosti zainteresiranih potencialnih upravičencev do DO, uporabnikov storitev in drugih posameznikov na neposreden in individualiziran način z vzpostavitvijo klicnega centra v letih od 2025 do 2027. Aktivnosti operacije/projekta so: I. Vodenje, spremljanje in usmerjanje operacije. II. Informiranje javnosti in promocija dolgotrajne oskrbe na nacionalni ravni. III. Vzpostavitev klicnega centra za neposredno informiranje o dolgotrajni oskrbi.

Operation_Name_English: The Plan Based Tool

Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is the development and marketing of Plan Based; A tool for managers with responsibility for P&L companies. The tool follows the principle of simplicity, which is placed side by side with Excel, enables collaboration and at the same time draws data from omnipresent external and internal sources. Developed plan models are transferable between companies and between countries. Thanks to modern technical approaches, Plan Based enables superior responsiveness, despite the creation of completely new data connections.
