Operation_Name_English: Quality Assessment Model and Competences of Long-Term Care Employees - Quality Long-Term Care
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Model presoje kakovosti in kompetence zaposlenih v dolgotrajni oskrbi - Kakovostna dolgotrajna oskrba
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the investment is to support the implementation process of ZDOsk-1. In order to ensure user-oriented care and strengthen the network of services, the purpose of the operation/project is to provide professional support and increased capacity of all stakeholders in the process of establishing DOs, while in particular strengthening the competences of employees in DOs and employees at the CSD for quality, safe and user-oriented care. Objectives of the operation/project: - Strengthen the capacities and improve the competences of experts at the CSD and at DO service providers for the provision and implementation of user-centred care and the development of the DO network. - Upgrade working methods and introduce innovations in DO, with the aim of developing person-centred care and ensuring life in the home environment, by providing professional support for employees at CSDs and DO coordinators at DO service providers. To enable effective monitoring of CSR, with the aim of timely identification of systemic deficiencies, challenges and impacts, by preparing methodological baselines and measurement instruments that will lay the foundations for systematic and long-term monitoring of CSR. To provide the foundation for a better quality of service and life for older people by developing a model for quality assessment in DOs and pilot testing of the model. The beneficiary will be the Institute of the Republic of Slovenia for Social Protection. The activities of the operation/project are: - project management, monitoring and coordination; - development of monitoring methodologies and quality assessment model for user-oriented long-term care - development of new competences of employees in long-term care - Information and communication on the content of the project
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen investicije je podpiranje procesa uveljavljanja ZDOsk-1. Za zagotovitev oskrbe, usmerjene v uporabnika in krepitev mreže storitev je namen operacije/projekta zagotoviti strokovno podporo in večjo zmogljivost vseh deležnikov v procesu vzpostavitve DO, pri tem pa še posebej okrepiti kompetence zaposlenih v DO in delavcev na CSD za kakovostno, varno in v uporabnika usmerjeno oskrbo. Cilji operacije/projekta: - Krepiti zmogljivosti in izboljšati kompetence strokovnjakov na CSD in pri izvajalcih storitev DO za zagotavljanje in izvajanje v uporabnika usmerjene oskrbe in razvoj mreže DO. - Nadgraditi metode dela in vpeljati inovacije v DO, z namenom razvoja v posameznika usmerjene oskrbe in zagotovitvijo življenja v domačem okolju, z nudenjem strokovne podpore za zaposlene na CSD in koordinatorje DO pri izvajalcih storitev DO. - Omogočiti učinkovito spremljanje DO, z namenom pravočasne identifikacije sistemskih pomanjkljivosti, izzivov in učinkov, s pripravo metodoloških izhodišč in merskih instrumentov, ki bodo postavila temelje za sistematično in dolgoročno spremljanje DO. - Zagotoviti temelje za večjo kakovost storitev in življenja starejših ljudi z oblikovanjem modela presojanja kakovosti v DO in pilotnega testiranja modela. Upravičenec bo Institut RS za socialno varstvo. Aktivnosti operacije/projekta so: - vodenje, spremljanje in koordinacija projekta; - razvoj metodologij spremljanja in modela presoje kakovosti za v uporabnika usmerjano dolgotrajno oskrbo - razvoj novih kompetenc zaposlenih v dolgotrajni oskrbi - Informiranje in komuniciranje o vsebini projekta

Operation_Name_English: Breast cancer apple skin innovative pouch

Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the submitted project, they are developing a new product Breast cancer apple skin innovative pouch. It is a post-surgical pocket made of bio-leather, which will be made using a special technological procedure from the waste of apple peels, which inhibits the formation of new cancer cells. It serves to stow and facilitate access to drainage pipes and pumps immediately after the operation. Later, when they are no longer needed, this innovative pocket is removed, unfastened and serves as a handbag for the user. The pocket is part of the entire sustainably designed clothing for cancer patients.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V sklopu prijavljenega projekta razvijajo nov izdelek Breast cancer apple skin innovative pouch. Gre za pokirurški žepek iz bio-usnja, ki bo narejen s posebnim tehnološkim postopkom iz odpadkov jabolčnih olupkov, ki zavirajo nastanek novih rakavih celic. Kasneje, ko le teh ne potrebujejo več, pa se ta inovativni žepek odstrani, odpne in služi kot torbica za uporabnico. Žepek je del celotnega trajnostno zasnovanega oblačila za rakave bolnice.

Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Primorsko-notranjska is part of the comprehensive PONI project, which is carried out throughout Slovenia. The purpose of the operation PONI Primorsko-Notranjska is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize the entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Primorsko-Notranjska region. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Primorsko-notranjska je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Primorsko-Notranjska je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Primorsko- Notranjski regiji. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_English: Centre for the Guidance of Deinstitutionalisation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Center za usmerjanje deinstitucionalizacije
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Deinstitutionalization (DI) is a process through which we transform institutions for people with disabilities and, as an alternative, provide diverse community-based services that enable personalized care, domestic living, and the realization of human rights of people with disabilities. DI is a long and complex social process that includes the process of planning the transformation of large institutions, establishing new services, improving living conditions, increasing the quality of life of people with disabilities, training employees, working with the community, as well as structural changes in social policy, legislation, connecting stakeholders and raising awareness among the wider professional and other public. In Slovenia, DI has a long history. In the past, there have already been the establishment of new services in the community, the partial transformation of institutions, the development of new knowledge, and several research projects have been carried out. This investment continues and upgrades the work of past DI processes in Slovenia, while for the first time addressing DI at the national level. The investment envisages the systematic, coordinated and high-quality introduction of DI in the field of care for children and adults with disabilities in Slovenia, as required by numerous international, European and Slovenian documents. In particular, the investment will support the implementation of the Deinstitutionalisation Strategy 2024-2034 (StaDI 2024-2034). Purpose and objectives The purpose of the investment is to provide professional support, monitor the DI process and coordinate work between different DI actors. At national level, the purpose of the investment is to provide operational support to SMEs in coordinating work across different portfolios, sectors and contractors. At the local level, the purpose of the investment is to provide field support to key stakeholders such as users and their loved ones, employees in institutions, community service providers, social work centres, municipalities, etc. The purpose of the investment ČUDI is also to develop new knowledge and raise public awareness of the DI process. The objectives of the investment are: - increased accessibility of the network of services and programmes in accordance with ReNPSV 22-30; - the coordinated implementation of the DI process and the involvement of various stakeholders in the process itself; - the development of new forms and methods of work in social care and long-term care, changes in the treatment of users and the individualisation of services; Enhancing the enjoyment of human rights by people with disabilities to live in the community and to decide where and with whom to live; - eliminating discrimination and stigma towards people with disabilities; - sensitising the environment to DI concepts and the rights of people with disabilities. The activities that will be carried out in 15 institutions are aimed at coordinating and leading the process of moving users to residential units for community living, training professional associates, users and their relatives, and raising awareness among the general public and the local community. We will evaluate the project and prepare a final research report.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Deinstitucionalizacija (DI) je proces, preko katerega preobrazimo institucije za ljudi z oviranostjo in kot alternativo zagotovimo raznolike storitve v skupnosti, ki omogočajo oskrbo po meri posameznika, življenje v domačem okolju, in uresničevanje človekovih pravic ljudi z oviranostjo. DI je dolgotrajen in kompleksen družbeni proces, ki vključuje postopek načrtovanja preobrazbe velikih institucij, vzpostavljanje novih storitev, izboljšanje bivalnih pogojev, večanje kakovosti življenja ljudi z oviranostjo, usposabljanje zaposlenih, delo s skupnostjo, obenem pa strukturne spremembe socialne politike, zakonodaje, povezovanje deležnikov in ozaveščanje širše strokovne in druge javnosti. V Sloveniji ima DI dolgoletno zgodovino. V preteklosti je že prišlo do vzpostavitve novih storitev v skupnosti, delne preobrazbe institucij, razvoja novega znanja, izvedenih pa je bilo tudi več raziskovalnih projektov. Pričujoča investicija nadaljuje in nadgrajuje delo preteklih procesov DI v Sloveniji, pri čemer pa se prvič loteva DI na nacionalni ravni. Investicija predvideva sistematično, koordinirano in kakovostno uvajanje DI za področje oskrbe otrok in odraslih z oviranostjo v Sloveniji, kot to narekujejo številni mednarodni, evropski in slovenski dokumenti. Investicija bo še posebej podprla izvajanje Strategije za deinstitucionalizacijo 2024-2034 (StaDI 2024-2034). Namen in cilji Namen investicije je zagotoviti strokovno podporo, spremljati proces DI in koordinirati delo med različnimi akterji DI. Na nacionalni ravni je namen investicije zagotavljati operativno podporo MSP pri usklajevanju dela med različnimi resorji, sektorji in izvajalci. Na lokalni ravni pa je namen investicije zagotavljati terensko podporo ključnim deležnikom kot so uporabniki in njihovim bližnji, zaposleni v zavodih, izvajalci storitev v skupnosti, centri za socialno delo, občine itn. Namen investicije CUDI je prav tako razvijati novo znanje in ozaveščati javnost o procesu DI. Cilji investicije so: - povečana dostopnost mreže služb in programov v skladu z ReNPSV 22-30; - koordinirano izvajanje procesa DI in vključevanje različnih deležnikov v sam proces; - razvoj novih in nadgradnja že obstoječih oblik in metod dela v socialnem varstvu in dolgotrajni oskrbi, sprememba obravnave uporabnikov ter individualizacija storitev; - krepitev uresničevanja človekovih pravic ljudi z oviranostjo, da živijo v skupnosti in odločajo, kje in s kom bodo živeli; - odpravljanje diskriminacije in stigme do oseb z oviranostjo; - senzibiliziranje okolja do konceptov DI in pravic ljudi z oviranostjo. Aktivnosti, ki jih bomo izvajali v 15 zavodih so usmerjene v koordinacijo in vodenje procesa preselitve uporabnikov v bivalne enote za bivanje v skupnosti, usposabljanje strokovnih sodelavcev, uporabnikov in njihovih sorodnikov ter ozaveščanje splošne javnosti in lokalne skupnosti. Projekt bomo evalvirali in pripravili tudi zaključno raziskovano poročilo.

Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurial over challenges - PONI Savinjska
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive - PONI Savinjska
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Savinjska is part of the comprehensive project PONI, which is carried out on the entire territory of Slovenia. The purpose of the operation PONI Savinjska is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize the entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Savinjska region. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Savinjska je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Savinjska je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Savinjski regiji. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrade of the weather-related emergency warning, awareness and adaptation system in a changed climate - SOVIR
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nadgradnja sistema za opozarjanje in osveščanje na vremensko pogojene izredne razmere ter prilagajanje nanje v spremenjenem podnebju – SOVIR
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will upgrade the system to better alert citizens to weather-related emergencies, which will become more frequent due to climate change. The system will make an important contribution to better protecting human lives and reducing damage in the event of natural disasters. It will be based on observations, measurements, forecasts and warnings from the competent state service. At the same time, it will provide climate information and projections for the long-term reduction of disaster-related risks under changed climate conditions. The project will renew web content for public information and warning, develop and upgrade tools for effective information and warning of dangerous meteorological, hydrological and oceanographic conditions and emergencies, and upgrade the measuring and information infrastructure for continuous monitoring and forecasting of meteorological, hydrological and oceanographic conditions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: S projektom se bo nadgradilo sistem za učinkovitejše opozarjanje državljanov pred vremensko pogojenimi izrednimi razmerami, ki bodo zaradi podnebnih sprememb vse pogostejše. Sistem bo pomembno prispeval k večji zaščiti človeških življenj in zmanjševanju škode ob naravnih nesrečah. Osnovan bo na opazovanjih, meritvah, napovedih in opozorilih pristojne državne službe. Hkrati bo zagotavljal podnebne informacije in projekcije za dolgoročno zmanjševanje z naravnimi nesrečami povezanih tveganj v spremenjenih podnebnih razmerah. V okviru projekta bodo prenovljene spletne vsebine za obveščanje in opozarjanje javnosti, razvita in nadgrajena orodja za učinkovito obveščanje in opozarjanje pred nevarnimi meteorološkimi, hidrološkimi in oceanografskimi razmerami in izrednimi dogodki ter nadgrajena bo merilna in informacijska infrastruktura za stalno spremljanje in napovedovanje meteoroloških, hidroloških in oceanografskih razmer.

Operation_Summary_English: The operation covers the development and launch of Solnera One - an innovative smart aeroponic device that allows the production of fresh food indoors using an automated watering system, AI-adapted LED lighting and IoT connectivity. The device combines technologically advanced aeroponics with smart light and aesthetic design, which separates it from existing solutions on the market. The main objective of the operation is the development of a smart aeroponic device, optimization of the lighting system and automation, and market validation and preparation for production.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija zajema razvoj in lansiranje Solnera One – inovativne pametne aeroponične naprave, ki omogoča pridelavo sveže hrane v notranjih prostorih z uporabo avtomatiziranega sistema zalivanja, AI prilagojene LED osvetlitve in IoT povezljivosti. Naprava združuje tehnološko napredno aeroponiko s pametno svetlobo in estetskim dizajnom, kar jo ločuje od obstoječih rešitev na trgu. Glavni cilj operacije je razvoj pametne aeroponične naprave, optimizacija svetlobnega sistema in avtomatizacije in validacija trga ter priprava na proizvodnjo.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading the electricity storage with the development of a specific algorithm for the management of the available electricity storage
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nadgradnja hranilnika električne električne energije z razvojem specifičnega algortima za upravljanje z razpoložljivo električno energijo hranilnika
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The course is an application (algorithm) for the management of energy from RES as a component of an energy storage, which enables economic, energy and social efficient management of energy produced from renewable energy sources-RES and defines the time and duration of its operation.Efficiently means multi-layered, comprehensive management:-economic: comparison of the production price and the market price at the time of charging the storage tank and calculation of the CCR in correlation with the price for the contract for the supply of electricity to final customers that has already been concluded;-energy: optimisation of the number of operating cycles in relation to the service life of the storage tank;-social: exploiting RES in the light of sustainability, reducing the carbon footprint and meeting environmental requirements in reducing greenhouse gas emissions. It is an application that global manufacturers of storage tanks need, especially in the light of adapting to the specific circumstances of individual countries.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet je aplikacija (algoritem) za upravljanje z energijo iz OVE kot komponenta hranilnika energije, ki omogoča ekonomsko, energetsko in družbeno učinkovito upravljanje z energijo proizvedeno iz obnovljivih virov energije-OVE in definira čas in trajanje delovanja le-tega.Učinkovito pomeni večplastno, celovito upravljanje:-ekonomsko: primerjava proizvodne in tržne cene v času polnjenja hranilnika ter izračun RVC v korelaciji s ceno za s že klenjene pogodbe o dobavi električne energije končnim kupcem;-energetsko: optimizacija števila ciklov delovanja glede na življenjsko dobo hranilnika;-družbeno: izkoriščanje OVE v luči trajnostne naravnanosti, zmanjševanja ogljičnega odtisa in izpolnjevanja okoljskih zahtev pri zmanjševanju emisij toplogrednih plinov. Gre za aplikacijo, ki jo svetovni proizvajalci hranilnikov potrebujejo, zlasti v luči prilagajanja na specifične okoliščine posameznih držav.

Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure|Digitalisation of urban transport|Alternative fuels infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the operation is the revitalization of the city center in order to relieve the burden on the city of Slovenj Gradec, which means the withdrawal of stationary traffic, the introduction of alternative forms of access and the arrangement of open public urban areas. The investment achieves the objectives of sustainable mobility within the framework of sustainable urban strategies and the objectives of an integrated transport strategy. The operation thus covers activities in the field of comprehensive renovation of streets and roads in accordance with the principles of sustainable mobility (Measure 1), pedestrian infrastructure (Measure 3), digitalisation to promote sustainable mobility (Measure 5), and activities in the field of the use of alternative fuels (Measure 6).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet operacije je revitalizacija mestnega jedra z namenom razbremenjevanja mesta Slovenj Gradec, kar pomeni umikanje mirujočega prometa, uvedbo alternativnih oblik dostopa in urejanje odprtih javnih mestnih površin. Operation_Name_English: Digital bridge: Digital inclusion of older people and employees
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalni most: Digitalna vključenost starejših in zaposlenih

Operation_Summary_English: In accordance with the DigComp 2.2 framework of digital competences for citizens, we have designed 11 comprehensive educational programmes, each of which covers the entire spectrum of digital competences under DigComp 2.2, i.e. all 5 areas of digital competences (i.e. information and data literacy, communication and cooperation, digital content creation, security and problem-solving) and all 21 key digital competences according to the DigComp 2.2 framework. At the basic level, programmes cover basic digital competences (level 1-2), while advanced programmes cover advanced digital competences (levels 3-8). The digital competences covered by each training programme are presented in more detail in the Annex to Form 3: Detailed content program.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru projekta Digitalni most smo skladno z okvirjem digitalnih kompetenc za državljane DigComp 2.2 oblikovali 11 celovitih izobraževalnih programov, izmed katerih vsak program pokriva celoten spekter digitalnih kompetenc po okviru DigComp 2.2, se pravi vseh 5 področij digitalnih kompetenc (tj. informacijska in podatkovna pismenost, komuniciranje in sodelovanje, ustvarjanje digitalnih vsebin, varnost in reševanje problemov) ter vseh 21 ključnih digitalnih kompetenc glede na okvir DigComp 2.2. Pri tem programi na osnovnem nivoju pokrivajo osnovne digitalne kompetence (stopnja 1-2), napredni programi pa pokrivajo napredne digitalne kompetence (stopnje 3-8). Podrobneje so digitalne kompetence, ki jih pokrivajo posamezni programi usposabljanja, predstavljene v prilogi Obrazec št. 3: podroben vsebinski program.

Operation_Name_English: Cycling and footpath on the part of the Istrian detachment in Koper
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kolesarska in pešpot na delu ulice Istrskega odreda v Kopru
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The investment plans to arrange a cycling and walking path on a part of the Istrian detachment street in Koper. It is planned to build an appropriate cycling connection and link it to the existing cycling network, thus establishing a single, functional, logical and user-appealing cycling connection within the zone between areas and points, which are among the most important generators of cycling traffic. A two-way one-sided cycle path is planned, running along the right bank of the Olm stream on the section from the Hofer shop to the road to Markovec in a total length of 398.3 m. At the same time as the new construction of the cycle path, a new construction of a sidewalk in a length of 398.3 m is planned. Both the sidewalk and the cycle path are illuminated by public lighting. The purpose of this investment is to ensure greater road safety for cyclists and pedestrians, reduce the negative impacts of motor traffic on the environment, promote sustainable mobility and the use of bicycles for everyday tasks as an alternative to car transport. Additional effects of the investment are enabling the development of recreational activities of people and thus a positive impact on their health. The investment in question promotes sustainable mobility in the municipality, which is covered by a sustainable urban strategy and, to the greatest extent possible, promotes an increase in the share of sustainable transport modes in the structure of daily mobility of the population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Investicija namerava urediti kolesarsko in pešpot na delu ulice Istrskega odreda v Kopru. Predvidena je gradnja ustrezne kolesarske povezave in navezava le-te na obstoječo kolesarsko mrežo, s tem pa vzpostavitev enotne, funkcionalne, logične in uporabnikom privlačne kolesarske povezave znotraj cone med območji in točkami, ki so med pomembnejšimi generatorji kolesarskega prometa. Predvidena je ureditev dvosmerne enostranske kolesarske steze, ki poteka vzdolž desnega brega Olmskega potoka na odseku od trgovine Hofer do ceste na Markovec v skupni dolžini 398,3 m. Sočasno z novogradnjo kolesarske steze je predvidena tudi novogradnja pločnika v dolžini 398,3 m. Tako pločnik, kakor tudi kolesarska steza se osvetlita z javno razsvetljavo. Namen predmetne investicije je zagotavljanje večje prometne varnosti kolesarjev in peščev, zmanjševanje negativnih vplivov motornega prometa na okolje, vzpodbujanje trajnostne mobilnosti in uporabe koles za vsakodnevna opravila, kot alternative avtomobilskim prevozom. Dodatni učinki investicije so še omogočanje razvoja rekreativne dejavnosti ljudi in s tem pozitivni vpliv na njihovo zdravje. Predmetna investicija spodbuja trajnostno mobilnost v občini, ki ga zajema trajnostna urbana strategija ter v največji meri spodbujajo dvig deleža trajnostnih prometnih načinov v strukturi dnevne mobilnosti prebivalstva.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive v Obalno-kraški regiji
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Obalno-kraška is part of the comprehensive project PONI, which is carried out on the whole of Slovenia. The purpose of the operation PONI Obalno-kraška is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize the entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Obalno-kraška region.. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the investment is the construction of an extension to the Slovenj Gradec Health Centre, which is part of a comprehensive urban renovation and internal development of the urban area. The investment focuses on the revitalisation and restructuring of underutilised urban areas and the optimisation of existing spatial arrangements, thereby improving the quality of the urban environment and creating conditions for sustainable development. By renovating and revitalising underutilised urban areas, the project will improve the quality of public infrastructure and create modern conditions for health care. The extension with a gross floor area of 1.966 m2 will be used for emergency medical assistance, health promotion centre, general medicine, community service and programmes for children and youth. The project is in line with the principles of the CTN and the objectives of the Sustainable Urban Strategy of the Municipality of Slovenj Gradec, as it contributes to the revitalization of the space, better use of the existing building land and an increase in the quality of living and accessibility of services for all residents, including vulnerable groups.

Investicija se osredotoča na oživljanje in prestrukturiranje slabo izkoriščenih urbanih površin ter optimizacijo obstoječe prostorske ureditve, s čimer se izboljšuje kakovost mestnega okolja in ustvarjajo pogoji za trajnostni razvoj. Projekt bo s prenovo in oživitvijo slabo izkoriščenih urbanih površin izboljšal kakovost javne infrastrukture in ustvaril sodobne pogoje za zdravstveno oskrbo. Operation_Name_English: inShift
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: inShift
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is the development of a solution: Eliminating jet lag by gradually shifting natural drowsiness to the desired time zone or clock. The core of the system is represented by two internally developed algorithms, which are based on the findings of more than 170 scientific researches on circadian rhythm; Algorithm for identifying an individual's biological clock based on data from the most comfortable sleep trackers and Algorithm for generating a personalized protocol for delaying the biological clock, which takes into account the user's personal limitations (tasks, reserved time for specific activities, commuting,...) and contains suggestions of the best time windows for exposure to light, sleep, meals, exercise, caffeine and more.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet projekta je razvoj rešitve: Eliminacija jet lag-a s postopnima zamikanjem naravne zaspanosti na željeno časovno cono oz. uro. Jedro sistema predstavljata dva interno razvita algoritma, ki bazirata na osnovi ugotovitev več kot 170ih znanstvenih raziskav o cirkadianskem ritmu; Algoritem za identifikacijo biološke ure posameznika na podlagi podatkov iz najudobneših sledilnikov spanja ter Algoritem za generiranje personaliziranega protokola za zamikanje biološke ure, ki upošteva uporabnikove osebne omejitve (opravila, rezerviran čas za specifične aktivnosti, vožnja v službo,...) in vsebuje predloge najboljših časovnih oken za izpostavljenost svetlobi, spanje, obroke, vadbo, kofein in več.

Operation_Name_English: DIGIKOMPAKT 2024-2025
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DIGIKOMPAKT 2024-2025
Category_Label: IT services and applications for digital skills and digital inclusion
Operation_Summary_English: The programme Basics Digital - PRACTICAL DIGITAL WRITING FOR EVERYONE focuses on the acquisition of basic digital competences of participants. The latter will learn about the importance of digital literacy for everyday life and learn about the DigComp 2.2 framework. The programme covers six key areas, including information and data literacy, communication and cooperation, content creation, digital security, problem solving and additional skills. Through the course, participants will learn basic digital data management skills, communicate through digital tools, create simple digital content, and ensure basic online security. The programme includes a target group of different digital services that participants will learn about at work. The Advanced Digital – Advanced Digital Competences programme aims to develop high and semi-medium levels of digital competence. It consists of five main competence groups, which include information and data literacy, communication and collaboration, digital content creation, security and problem-solving. Each group offers specific goals and skills, such as advanced data search and filtering techniques, the use of business communication tools, the creation of complex digital content, and the protection of devices and digital content. The programme also includes services and data sources such as the European Data Portal, SiStat, the EU Business Register, and communication tools such as Zoom, Miro and Slack. Through the programme, evaluation is carried out and feedback is obtained for continuous improvement of competences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Program Osnove Digitalno - PRAKTIČNA DIGITALNA PISMENOST ZA VSAKEGA je osredotočen na pridobivanje osnovnih digitalnih kompetenc udeležencev. Slednji bodo spoznali pomen digitalne pismenosti za vsakdanje življenje in se seznanili z okvirjem DigComp 2.2. Program pokriva šest ključnih področij, vključno z informacijsko in podatkovno pismenostjo, komunikacijo in sodelovanjem, ustvarjanjem vsebin, digitalno varnostjo ter reševanjem težav in dodatnimi znanji. Skozi tečaj se bodo udeleženci naučili osnovnih veščin upravljanja z digitalnimi podatki, komunicirati prek digitalnih orodij, ustvarjati preproste digitalne vsebine ter zagotavljati osnovno varnosti na spletu. Program vključuje ciljno skupino različnih digitalnih storitev, ki jih bodo udeleženci spoznali pri delu. Program Napredno Digitalno – Napredne digitalne kompetence je namenjen razvoju visokih in delno srednjih ravni digitalnih kompetenc. Sestavljen je iz petih glavnih skupin kompetenc, ki vključujejo informacijsko in podatkovno pismenost, komunikacijo in sodelovanje, ustvarjanje digitalnih vsebin, varnost ter reševanje problemov. Vsaka skupina ponuja specifične cilje in veščine, kot so napredne tehnike iskanja in filtriranja podatkov, uporaba poslovnih komunikacijskih orodij, ustvarjanje kompleksnih digitalnih vsebin in zaščita naprav ter digitalnih vsebin. Program vključuje tudi storitve in vire podatkov, kot so European Data Portal, SiStat, EU Business Register, ter orodja za komunikacijo, kot so Zoom, Miro in Slack. Skozi program se izvaja evalvacija in pridobiva povratna informacija za stalno izboljšanje kompetenc.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the quality and accessibility of green urban infrastructure in the area of SRC Bonifika
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izboljšanje kakovosti in dostopnosti zelene mestne infrastrukture na območju ŠRC Bonifika
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of this investment is to provide accessible and attractive green urban infrastructure, taking into account the principle of using nature-based solutions. The investment is intended for all residents of the area and other potential users (residents from other places, tourists). With the implementation of the investment project, the municipality will enable infrastructural conditions for the implementation of additional/new outdoor sports activities. This will contribute to a more active and healthy lifestyle of the population and improve the quality of life of the local population. The planned contents of the project will have a public interest character in the field of sustainable urban development with a positive impact on the wider social, social and also economic environment. The project will establish the appropriate infrastructure for the implementation of outdoor sports activities, which will enable a more friendly stay and further sustainable development of the society, the town and, consequently, the municipality and the region. The green infrastructure of the city will be a space for urban life, a space for socializing, relaxation and recreation, which will positively contribute to the promotion of social interaction, intergenerational and intercultural integration for better social inclusion. Green urban areas as a central vehicle of sports and recreation infrastructure will be important for the promotion of a healthy active style, active leisure time for all residents of the urban area of Koper and visitors. In this respect, they are also very important as one of the pillars of Koper's development as a year-round, active, green, sports and tourist destination. The investment means quality and content enrichment and replenishment of the city center, the nearby residential and tourist areas and the wider region, which will allow the population an abundance of versatile active physical recreation and, consequently, help to increase active work readiness in the lifelong work process. Improved green infrastructure in the city will be publicly available and will follow the principles of nature-based solutions. Use of pumtrack will be free of charge.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen predmetne investicije je zagotoviti dostopno in privlačno zeleno urbano infrastrukturo z upoštevanjem načela uporabe na naravi temelječih rešitev. Investicija je namenjena vsem prebivalcem območja in ostalim potencialnim uporabnikom (prebivalci iz drugih krajev, turisti). Z izvedbo investicijskega projekta bo občina omogočila infrastrukturne pogoje za izvajanje dodatnih/novih športnih aktivnosti na prostem. Navedeno bo pripomoglo k bolj aktivnemu in zdravemu življenjskemu slogu prebivalstva ter izboljšanju kvalitete življenja lokalnega prebivalstva. Načrtovane vsebine v okviru projekta bodo imele značaj javnega interesa na področju trajnostnega urbanega razvoja s pozitivnim učinkom na širše socialno, družbeno in tudi gospodarsko okolje. S projektom bo vzpostavljena ustrezna infrastruktura za izvajanje športnih aktivnosti na prostem, ki bo omogočila prijaznejše bivanje ter nadaljnji trajnostni razvoj družbe, kraja ter posledično občine in regije. Zelena infrastruktura mesta bo prostor urbanega življenja, prostor za druženje, sprostitev in rekreacijo, kar bo ugodno prispevalo k spodbujanju socialne interakcije, medgeneracijskega in medkulturnega povezovanja za boljšo družbeno vključenost. Zelene mestne površine kot osrednji nosilec športno-rekreacijske infrastrukture bodo pomembne za spodbujanje zdravega aktivnega sloga, aktivno preživljanje prostega časa za vse prebivalce urbanega območja Koper in obiskovalce. V tem pogledu pa so zelo pomembne tudi kot eden izmed stebrov razvoja Kopra kot celoletne, aktivne, zelene, športne in turistične destinacije. Investicija pomeni kakovostno in vsebinsko popestritev ter dopolnitev mestnemu središču, bližnjim stanovanjskim in turističnim območjem ter širši regiji, kar bo prebivalstvu omogočilo obilo vsestranske aktivne fizične rekreacije in posledično pripomoglo k večji aktivni delovni pripravljenosti v vseživljenjskem delovnem procesu. Izboljšana zelena infrastruktura v mestu bo javno dostopna in bo sledila načelom na naravi temelječih rešitev. Uporaba pumtracka bo brezplačna.

Operation_Summary_English: Incarcerated persons will be able to obtain formal education for different levels of school education, namely: obtaining professional and vocational education at the level of lower (lower vocational school), secondary vocational (secondary vocational school), secondary (secondary technical and other secondary vocational schools) and also higher education (higher vocational school). Operation_Name_English: Smart power management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Smart power management
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The operation includes the development, manufacture and sale of a system for the control and management of household electricity consumption, with the aim of reducing monthly electricity costs. The system includes a central metering unit that measures consumption in the main electrical cabinet and is connected to the RAIN mesh network, and sends data to the server that is displayed to the user in the mobile application, as well as smart relay modules that are installed behind existing sockets or switches and measure consumption, allow on/off and are wirelessly connected to the RAIN mesh, which allows communication with the main metering unit and the server.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija vključuje razvoj, izdelavo in prodajo sistema za nadzor in upravljanje porabe električne energije v gospodinjstvih, z namenom znižanja mesečnih stroškov električne energije. Sistem vključuje centralno merilno enoto, ki meri porabo v glavni električni omarici in je povezana v omrežje RAIN mesh ter na strežnik pošilja podatke, ki se uporabniku prikazujejo v mobilni aplikaciji ter pametne relejne module, ki so nameščeni za obstoječimi vtičnicami ali stikali in merijo porabo, omogočajo vklop/ izklop ter so brezžično povezani v RAIN mesh, kar omogoča komunikacijo z glavno merilno enoto in strežnikom.

Operation_Name_English: Sustainable mobility in Velenje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Trajnostna mobilnost v Velenju
Category_Label: Clean urban transport infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: MOV has approached the implementation of the investment project Sustainable Mobility in Velenje, which aims to improve sustainable mobility in the city by carrying out maintenance works on the existing pedestrian infrastructure, building additional public infrastructure for cyclists and installing a charging station for commercial electric vehicles. The specific objectives of the project are: - Measure 1: implementation of maintenance works on existing public pedestrian areas (Cankarjeva ulica), - Measure 2: construction of additional public cycling infrastructure as part of the system of renting public bicycles (the installation of 2 stations with one 10 places and one 6 parking spaces and the purchase of 5 electric and 5 classic bicycles), and - Measure 3: In order to promote the use of alternative vehicles, it is envisaged to install 1 charging station for electric vehicles, with a power of at least 150 kW (1 connection point). The above-mentioned objectives of the project "Sustainable mobility in Velenje" are consistent with the eligible purposes for the selection of operations under the "European Cohesion Policy Programme 2021 - 2027", policy objective 2 "A greener, low-carbon Europe that is resilient and transitions towards a zero-carbon economy by promoting clean and fair energy transition, green and blue investment, the circular economy, climate change mitigation and adaptation, risk prevention and management, and sustainable urban mobility", priority 4 "Sustainable mobility", specific objective RSO2.8 "Promoting sustainable multimodal urban mobility in the context of the transition towards a net-zero carbon economy". Operation_Name_English: Fluid Doctor – a smart device for cleaning cooling fluids in the metalworking industry
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Fluid Doctor – pametna naprava za čiščenje hladilnih tekočin v industriji obdelave kovin
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The solution is the "Fluid Doctor", a smart device for cleaning cooling liquids. With a combination of UV-C sterilization, microfiltration and waste oil extraction, it extends the life of cooling fluids up to 6 times, while operating in a fully automated and chemical-free manner. It is an innovation that is the result of our own development and in the process of patent and design protection. The installation improves the consumption of raw materials, facilitates recycling and the sustainable use and protection of water resources.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rešitev je »Fluid Doctor«, pametna naprava za čiščenje hladilnih tekočin. S kombinacijo UV-C sterilizacije, mikrofiltracije in izločanja odpadnega olja podaljša življenjsko dobo hladilnih tekočin do 6-krat, pri tem pa deluje popolnoma avtomatizirano in brez kemikalij. Gre za inovacijo, ki je plod lastnega razvoja ter v postopku zaščite patenta in modela. Z napravo se izboljša poraba surovin, omogoča se recikliranje ter trajnostna raba in varstvo vodnih virov.

Operation_Summary_English: The Velenje Technology Park - TECHUB (entrepreneurial incubator) represents the basic development infrastructure that enables the transition of the SAŠA region from the coal past to a smart, digital and sustainable future. The purpose of the project is the construction and equipment of a new facility for the needs of the business incubator within the business zone Stara vas, which is a degraded area, with the aim of providing quality premises and programs for new and developing companies. It will provide the necessary support (providing infrastructural conditions and providing support services) for the creation and growth and development of new enterprises, while at the same time it will represent a stimulating environment or a meeting point of cooperation between the entrepreneurial and research spheres in the direction of knowledge transfer, joint RDI projects, restructuring and development of the economy in the direction of material and energy efficiency and environmentally friendly development of coal regions. The goal of TECHUB is to create a stimulating environment where entrepreneurs and individuals can develop their ideas into successful companies. It offers comprehensive support, including physical facilities, access to technology, business mentoring, educational programs and networking with potential investors. The gross floor area of the building will be 5,788.04 m2. The newly equipped usable areas intended for entrepreneurial content will amount to 5,110.34 m2, and 3,169.79 m2 will be available to incubated companies. The project indicators are: supported investment projects (1), newly arranged land for business activity (0.578 ha), occupancy of newly arranged usable land intended for entrepreneurial content (86%), number of incubators to be included in the incubator (48, of which 30 from the field of S5), 145 trainings or workshops in the field of entrepreneurship will be carried out, 30 research and other projects will be carried out by incubators, 75 jobs will be created by newly established companies included in the incubator.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tehnološki park Velenje - TECHUB (podjetniški inkubator) predstavlja temeljno razvojno infrastrukturo, ki omogoča prehod SAŠA regije iz premogovne preteklosti v pametno, digitalno in trajnostno prihodnost. Namen projekta je izgradnja in oprema novega objekta za potrebe podjetniškega inkubatorja znotraj poslovne cone Stara vas, ki je degradirano območje, s ciljem zagotavljanja kvalitetnih prostorov in programov za nova in razvijajoča podjetja. Nudil bo potrebno podporo (zagotavljanje infrastrukturnih pogojev in nudenje podpornih storitev) za nastanek in rast ter razvoj novih podjetij, hkrati pa bo predstavljal spodbudno okolje oz. stičišče sodelovanja med podjetni in raziskovalno sfero v smeri prenosa znanja, skupnih RRI projektov, prestrukturiranja in razvoja gospodarstva v smeri snovne in energetske učinkovitosti ter okolju prijaznega razvoja premogovnih regij. Cilj TECHUB-a je ustvariti spodbudno okolje, kjer bodo lahko podjetniki in fizične osebe razvijali svoje ideje v uspešna podjetja. Ponuja celovito podporo, vključno s fizičnimi prostori, dostopom do tehnologije, poslovnim mentorstvom, izobraževalnimi programi in povezovanjem s potencialnimi investitorji. Bruto tlorisna površina objekta bo znašala 5.788,04 m2. Novo opremljenih uporabnih površin namenjenih za podjetniške vsebine bo znašala 5.110,34 m2, inkubiranim podjetjem bo na voljo 3.169,79 m2. Kazalniki projekta so: podprti investicijski projekti (1), novo urejene površine za gosp. dejavnost (0,578 ha), zasedenost novo urejenih uporabnih površin namenjenih za podjetniške vsebine (86 %), število inkubirancev, ki bodo vključeni v inkubator (48, od tega 30 s področja S5), izvedenih bo 145 usposabljanj ali delavnic s področja podjetništva, izvedenih bo 30 raziskovalnih in drugih projektov s strani inkubirancev, ustvarjenih bo 75 delovnih mest s strani novoustanovljenih podjetij, vključenih v inkubator.

Operation_Name_English: Arrangement of Langer's Villa
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ureditev Langerjeve vile
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The reconstruction of Langer's villa follows the original symmetrical character of the villa, and the annexed kitchen on the northwest part of the building from 1958 is thus removed. On the ground floor of the building, all partitions are removed, only the primary wall structure remains. The new functional design of the building follows the existing design, the ground floor is divided into a central common part with a main entrance and a multifunctional hall with a loggia and two wings, in the east a cafeteria is envisaged, and in the west the premises of the Koroška Gate City Quarter. Through the existing staircase, access is made to the 1st floor, where the original design of the staircase hall is exposed and maintained, the wings of the floor are cleaned of non-quality alterations, office spaces are arranged in them. In the so-called mezzanine, the central space above the multifunctional hall, a modular meeting room is arranged, which allows different uses and subdivision of the space. In the basement of the building there is an exhibition space in the area below the multifunctional hall, in the wings of the basement there are service rooms. The arrangement of the outdoor areas will clearly define the open paved space around the building, the parking lots will be arranged east of the building, on the most remote lane along Mladinska Street, and the park areas in the south will be arranged by preserving the existing and adding new vegetation to follow the historical design, which will be in line with the symmetrical design of the villa. The investor of the Municipality of Maribor, as part of the arrangement of the surroundings of the western stands of the People's Garden, decides to approach the arrangement of open areas, which, with the newly placed, planned contents, would be part of the degraded, unregulated space of the area of the People's Garden.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija Langerjeve vile sledi prvotnemu simetričnemu značaju vile, prizidana kuhinja na SZ delu objekta iz leta 1958 se tako odstrani. V pritličju objekta se odstranijo vse predelne stene, ostane samo primarna stenska konstrukcija. Nova funkcionalna zasnova objekta sledi obstoječi oblikovni zasnovi, pritličje se deli na osrednji skupni del z glavnim vhodom in večnamensko dvorano z loggio ter dve krili, v vzhodnem se predvidi kavarna, v zahodnem pa prostori Mestne četrti Koroška vrata. Preko obstoječega stopnišča se dostopa v 1. nadstropje, kjer se izpostavi in ohranja prvotno oblikovanje stopniščne avle, krila nadstropja se očistijo nekvalitetnih predelav, v njih se uredijo pisarniški prostori. V t.i. medetaži, osrednjem prostoru nad večnamensko dvorano se uredi modularna sejna soba, ki omogoča različne rabe in pregrajevanje prostora. V kleti objekta je predviden razstaviščni prostor v območju pod večnamensko dvorano, v krilih kleti so servisni prostori. Z ureditvijo zunanjih površin se bo jasno definiral odprt tlakovan prostor okoli objekta, parkirišča se bodo uredila vzhodno od objekta, na najbolj odmaknjenem pasu ob Mladinski ulici, parkovne površine na jugu pa se bodo z ohranjanjem obstoječe in dodajanjem nove vegetacije uredile, da bodo sledile historični zasnovi, ki bo skladna s simetrično zasnovo vile. Investitorka Mestna občina Maribor se v sklopu ureditve okolice zahodne tribune Ljudskega vrta odloča pristopiti k ureditvi odprtih površin, ki bi z novo umeščenimi, predvidenimi vsebinami del degradiranega, neurejenega prostora območja Ljudskega vrta.

Category_Label: Measures to improve the accessibility, effectiveness and resilience of healthcare systems (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of upgrading the testing system, which, in addition to illicit drugs and new psychoactive substances, will also enable the analysis of illicit substances in sport and other substances that improve physical fitness and appearance, the detection of the presence of these substances in products on the free market and on the black market, which is the basis for the preparation of harm reduction, prevention and awareness-raising measures. The objectives of the project are: 1) Analysis of illicit drugs and new psychoactive substances and reporting of results to the Early Warning System for the Phenomenon of New Psychoactive Substances (EWS) and users, with the aim of reducing harm and strengthening the service of advice to users; 2) Analysis of samples for the presence of illicit substances in sport and other substances that improve physical fitness and appearance and reporting of results to the database and users with the aim of reducing harm; 3) Establishment of a system for collecting samples of illicit substances in sport and other substances that improve the physical abilities and appearance of anonymous users, the provision of advice and other harm reduction services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen nadgradnje sistema testiranja, ki bo poleg prepovedanih drog in novih psihoaktivnih snovi omogočal tudi analizo nedovoljenih snovi v športu in drugih snovi, ki izboljšujejo telesne sposobnosti in izgled, ugotavljanje prisotnosti teh snovi v izdelkih v prosti prodaji in na črnem trgu, kar predstavlja podlago za pripravo ukrepov zmanjševanja škode, preventive in ozaveščanja. Cilji projekta so: 1) Analiza prepovedanih drog in novih psihoaktivnih snovi ter poročanje rezultatov v Sistem za zgodnje opozarjanje na pojav novih psihoaktivnih snovi (EWS) in uporabnikom, z namenom zmanjševanja škode in krepitev storitve svetovanja uporabnikom; 2) Analiza vzorcev na prisotnost nedovoljenih snovi v športu in drugih snovi, ki izboljšujejo telesne sposobnosti in izgled in poročanje rezultatov v bazo podatkov in uporabnikom z namenom zmanjševanja škode; 3) Vzpostavitev sistema zbiranja vzorcev nedovoljenih snovi v športu in drugih snovi, ki izboljšujejo telesne sposobnosti in izgled anonimnih uporabnikov, izvajanja svetovanja in drugih storitev zmanjševanja škode.

Operation_Name_English: Space Guardian
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Space Guardian
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: The object of the project is Space Guardian, which offers a fully automated system to prevent collisions of satellites in an increasingly congested earth orbit. The core of the system is an algorithm for real-time risk assessment of potential collisions based on current orbital data, a system for optimising satellite paths (trajectory) and an innovative bidding mechanism that enables coordinated decision-making between satellites in the event of a collision. The company's goal is to build a recognizable and trustworthy brand that will be synonymous with technological excellence in orbital safety management.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet projekta je Space Guardian, ki ponuja popolnoma avtomatiziran sistem za preprečevanje trkov satelitov v vse bolj obremenjeni zemeljski orbiti. Jedro sistema predstavlja algoritem za sprotno ocenjevanje tveganja potencialnih trkov na podlagi aktualnih orbitalnih podatkov, sistem za optimizacijo satelitskih poti (trajektorij) ter inovativen dražbeni mehanizem (ang. bidding), ki omogoča usklajeno odločanje med sateliti ob nevarnosti trčenja. Cilj podjetja je zgraditi prepoznavno in zaupanja vredno blagovno znamko, ki bo sinonim za tehnološko odličnost na področju upravljanja orbitalne varnosti.

Operation_Summary_English: Centres for Social Work (CSD), (16 regional CSDs in Slovenia) are entry points for the implementation of the Long-Term Care Act (Zdosk-1). The tasks will start in early 2025. Their work includes assessing the needs of beneficiaries, issuing decisions and exchanging data with other stakeholders involved in the implementation of Zdosk-1. Despite the fact that the state has provided human resources for the implementation of the law, a lot of coordination, information exchange and cooperation will be required at the beginning of the implementation, which will be difficult at the beginning, since there will not yet be a comprehensive information system that supports Zdosk-1. Therefore, this operation will provide additional human resources from January 2025 to June 2027. Coordination of the operation of entry points will ensure a smooth process of operation of entry points and enable beneficiaries to receive appropriate DO services, as set out in Article 88 ZDOsk-1. The objectives of the operation are: - support for the process of establishing and operating entry points for DOs, - coordination, connection and coordination of the work of DO coordinators, - coordination, connection and coordination of the work of service providers, - coordination, connection and coordination of the work of administrative and administrative workers, - coordination, connection and coordination of the work of actors operating within all locally competent entry points for DOs. The envisaged acts of the operation are: Activity 1: Management and coordination of the investment activity Activity 2: Information to the public and promotion of long-term care at national level

Naloge bodo začeli izvajati v začetku leta 2025. Njihovo delo zajema ocenjevanje potreb upravičencev, izdajo odločb in izmenjavo podatkov z drugimi deležniki, vključenimi v izvajanje Zdosk-1. Kljub temu, da je država zagotovila kadrovske resurse za izvajanje zakona, bo ob začetku izvajanja potrebno veliko koordinacije, izmenjave informacij in sodelovanja, kar bo na začetku oteženo, saj še ne bo celovitega informacijskega sistema, ki bi podpiral Zdosk-1. Zato bomo s to operacijo zagotovili dodatne kadrovske resurse od januarja 2025 do junija 2027. Koordinacija delovanja vstopnih točk bo zagotavljala nemoten proces delovanja vstopnih točk ter omogočala, da upravičenci prejmejo ustrezne storitve DO, kot jih določa ZDOsk-1 v 88. členu. Cilji operacije so: - podpora procesu vzpostavljanja in delovanja vstopnih točk za DO, - koordinacija, povezovanje in usklajevanje dela koordinatorjev DO, - koordinacija, povezovanje in usklajevanje dela izvajalcev storitev, - koordinacija, povezovanje in usklajevanje dela upravno-administrativnih delavcev, - koordinacija, povezovanje in usklajevanje dela akterjev, ki delujejo v sklopu vseh krajevno pristojnih vstopnih točk za DO. Operation_Name_English: DIGI-DEVELOPMENT: Raising awareness and developing the digital skills of adult employees in companies and the general public

Operation_Summary_English: As part of the DIGI-DEVELOPMENT operation, seven advanced educational programmes are designed, which comprehensively cover all five key areas of digital competence according to DigComp 2.2 and all 21 key digital competences according to the DigComp 2.2 framework. In total, the programmes consist of more than 50 specific content directly related to digital services and applications relevant to the modern digital society. We also included 12 different digital services in each program, such as e-mail, eGovernment, eHealth and video call services. Each programme is completed with a section dedicated to assessment and further learning, thus promoting critical self-reflection and continuous education. Each programme is designed to enable participants to acquire and upgrade the knowledge and skills needed to use digital technologies effectively and safely in everyday life and at work. The programmes are adapted to the needs of the adult population of Slovenia over the age of 30 and are aimed at raising advanced digital competences. They cover topics from the use of social networks and esthetics to programming and digital design, paying special attention to security, privacy and ethical aspects of digitalisation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: V okviru operacije DIGI-RAZVOJ je oblikovanihi sedem naprednih izobraževalnih programov, ki celovito pokrivajo vseh pet ključnih področij digitalnih kompetenc po DigComp 2.2 ter vseh 21 ključnih digitalnih kompetenc glede na okvir DigComp 2.2. Skupno so programi sestavljeni iz več kot 50 specifičnih vsebin, ki so neposredno povezane z digitalnimi storitvami in aplikacijami, relevantnimi za sodobno digitalno družbo. V vsak program smo vključili tudi 12 različnih digitalnih storitev, kot so epošta, eUprava, eZdravje in storitve za videoklice. Vsak program zaključimo s sklopom, namenjenim oceni in nadaljnjemu učenju, s čimer spodbujamo kritično samorefleksijo in kontinuirano izobraževanje. Vsak program je zasnovan tako, da udeležencem omogoča pridobivanje in nadgradnjo znanj ter spretnosti, potrebnih za učinkovito in varno uporabo digitalnih tehnologij v vsakdanjem življenju in na delovnem mestu. Programi so prilagojeni potrebam odraslih prebivalcev Slovenije, starejših od 30 let, in so usmerjeni v dvig naprednih digitalnih kompetenc. Zajemajo teme od uporabe družbenih omrežij in estoritev do programiranja in digitalnega oblikovanja, pri čemer posebno pozornost namenjamo varnosti, zasebnosti in etičnim vidikom digitalizacije.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ureditev skupne površine za mešan promet pešcev in kolesarjev med Slovenskim trgom in Stritarjevo ulico (Brioni)
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The planned investment envisages the arrangement of a common area for mixed traffic of pedestrians and cyclists between Slovenska trg and Stritarjeva ulica. The central part of the area is the platform in front of the building of the Municipality of Kranj, which has been declared a cultural monument of national importance. The planned investment will eliminate 53 parking spaces and allocate the entire area of 2,553.80 m2 to cyclists and pedestrians. As part of the planned investment, facilities and traffic calming measures will be installed to ensure safer and more pleasant pedestrian traffic, urban equipment will be installed and measures for the comfort and attractiveness of pedestrian infrastructure will be implemented. A new station of the public bike rental system KRsKOLESOM will also be installed in order to maximize the number of people who would go on daily errands with a bicycle. The purpose of the project is to contribute to the achievement of the primary objectives of transport policy: – increasing the number of commuting by bicycle and increasing the share of cycling in urban travel, – reducing the use of private vehicles in the city, – promoting the creation of a sustainable transport system, – providing conditions for attractive, safe and comfortable walking and cycling in the city, – increasing the share of walking in urban travel and the presence of pedestrians in the city, – increasing road safety for the two most vulnerable groups in road transport: pedestrians and cyclists, as well as persons with disabilities and the visually impaired, - reducing CO2 and PM emissions in the city, - improving air quality, including through newly planted areas, - reducing noise pollution in the Kranj urban area, - reducing the number of kilometres travelled by passenger cars and - contributing to social change and raising social awareness. The planned investment is an operation in public infrastructure that is in the public interest. Works will be carried out in accordance with Article 21 of the Roads Act (ZCes-2) – maintenance works in the public interest, therefore no building permit is required.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Načrtovana investicija predvideva ureditev skupne površine za mešan promet pešcev in kolesarjev med Slovenskim trgom in Stritarjevo ulico. Osrednji del območja urejanja predstavlja ploščad pred stavbo Mestne občine Kranj, ki je bila razglašena za kulturni spomenik državnega pomena. Z načrtovano investicijo se bo ukinilo 53 parkirnih mest in se celotno površino v izmeri 2.553,80 m2 namenilo kolesarjem in pešcem. V sklopu načrtovane investicije bodo nameščene tudi naprave in ukrepi za umirjanje prometa, ki bodo zagotovili varnejši in prijetnejši promet pešcev, postavljena urbana oprema in izvedeni ukrepi za udobnost in privlačnost infrastrukture za pešce. Postavljena bo tudi nova postaja sistema izposoje javnih koles KRsKOLESOM z namenom čim večjega števila ljudi, ki bi se po dnevnih opravkih podali s kolesom. Namenski cilj projekta je prispevanje k zadovoljevanju primarnih ciljev prometne politike: – povečanje števila dnevnih migracij s kolesom in povečanju deleža kolesarjenja v mestnih potovanjih, – zmanjšanje uporabe osebnih vozil v mestu, – spodbujanje ustvarjanja trajnostnega prometnega sistema, – zagotavljanje pogojev za privlačno, varno in udobno hojo in kolesarjenje v mestu, – povečanje deleža pešačenja v mestnih potovanjih in prisotnost pešcev v mestu, – povečanju prometne varnosti dveh najbolj ranljivih skupin v cestnem prometu: pešcev in kolesarjev, pa tudi invalidov ter slepih in slabovidnih, – zmanjšanje emisij CO2 in PM delcev v mestu, – izboljšanje kakovosti zraka, tudi z novo zasajenimi površinami, – zmanjšanje obremenitev s hrupom v mestnem naselju Kranj, – zmanjšanje števila prevoženih kilometrov z osebnimi avtomobili in – prispevanje k družbeni spremembi ter dvigu družbene ozaveščenosti. Pri načrtovani investiciji gre za operacijo v javno infrastrukturo, ki je v javnem interesu. Dela se bodo izvedla skladno z 21. členom Zakona o cestah (ZCes-2) – vzdrževalna dela v javno korist, zato gradbenega dovoljenja ni potrebno pridobiti.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strateško razvojno-inovacijsko partnerstvo – Mreže za prehod v krožno gospodarstvo
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The strategic development and innovation partnership for the transition to a circular economy focuses on the transition to a circular economy and prioritises horizontal technologies in energy and material efficiency and technological processes: hydrogen, biorefineries, CO2 capture and storage, biofuels, secondary raw material processing technologies, biomaterials and circular business models. In addition, it focuses on the entire system of transition to a circular economy by promoting testing of new technologies and product development according to the principles of circular design. The focus areas of the smart and circular economy are reflected in sustainable energy, biomass and alternative raw materials, secondary raw materials, functional materials, processes and technologies, and circular business models.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Strateško razvojno-inovacijsko partnerstvo za prehod v krožno gospodarstvo je osredotočen na prehod v krožno gospodarstvo in prednostno horizontalne tehnologije energetske in snovne učinkoviti ter tehnoloških procesov: vodika, biorafinerije, zajem in skladiščenje CO2, biogoriva, tehnologije za pripravo sekundarnih surovin, biomaterialov in krožnih poslovnih modelov. Dodatno je usmerjen v celotni sistem prehoda v krožno gospodarstvo s promocijo testiranja novih tehnologij in razvoja izdelkov po načelih krožnega dizajna. Fokusna področja pametne in krožnega gospodarstva se izražajo v trajnostni energiji, biomasi in alternativnih surovinah, sekundarnih surovinah, funkcionalnih materialih, procesih in tehnologijah ter krožnih poslovnih modelih.

Operation_Name_English: MAG-NET
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MAG-NET
Operation_Summary_English: MAG-NET aims to address the talent drain in Celje and Prebold, two neighbour towns in Slovenia. Acknowledging the trend of talents moving to larger cities, the project introduces a two-folded strategy: firstly, it establishes the MAG-NET Hub, an interdisciplinary innovation and entrepreneurship space supported by a digital platform; secondly, it initiates five Urban Real-Life Learning Labs, concentrating on crucial areas such as affordable housing, sustainable mobility, industry 4.0, urban atmosphere, and community energy. The innovative solution proposed by the project is based on three key elements: providing a dynamic platform for youth to engage with urban challenges, encouraging collaborative efforts among stakeholders, and involving citizens in co-creating tangible urban improvements. Addressing depopulation, lack of attractive jobs, and untapped local talent resources, the MAG-NET model promises lasting impact through a permanent SPACELAB, fostering skill development and inter-sectoral collaboration. It aspires to redefine Celje and Prebold, creating sustainable, participatory frameworks for urban development, boosting the demand and supply of talents, and nurturing inclusive local growth.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: MAG-NET želi naslavljati odtok talentov v Celju in Preboldu, dveh sosednjih mestih v Sloveniji. Projekt priznava trend prehajanja talentov v večja mesta in uvaja dvojno strategijo: prvič, vzpostavlja vozlišče MAG-NET, interdisciplinarni inovacijski in podjetniški prostor, ki ga podpira digitalna platforma; drugič, uvaja pet urbanih laboratorijev za učenje v realnem življenju, ki se osredotočajo na ključna področja, kot so cenovno dostopna stanovanja, trajnostna mobilnost, industrija 4.0, mestno vzdušje in energija skupnosti. Inovativna rešitev, ki jo predlaga projekt, temelji na treh ključnih elementih: zagotavljanje dinamične platforme za mlade za spopadanje z mestnimi izzivi, spodbujanje skupnih prizadevanj deležnikov in vključevanje državljanov v soustvarjanje oprijemljivih izboljšav mest. Model MAG-NET, ki obravnava odseljevanje, pomanjkanje privlačnih delovnih mest in neizkoriščene lokalne vire talentov, obljublja trajen učinek s stalno preslednico, ki spodbuja razvoj spretnosti in medsektorsko sodelovanje. Prizadeva si za ponovno opredelitev Celja in Prebolda, ustvarjanje trajnostnih, participativnih okvirov za razvoj mest, povečanje povpraševanja in ponudbe talentov ter spodbujanje vključujoče lokalne rasti.

Operation_Name_English: CoMET - Development of innovative cobalt welding wires, tools and the concept of endless reuse of secondary waste
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CoMET - Razvoj inovativnih kobaltovih varilnih žic, orodij ter koncepta neskončne ponovne uporabe sekundarnega odpada
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Metal Tech Solutions develops an innovative solution called CoMET for the use of rare elements such as cobalt in various industries, especially in the steel industry. The approach focuses on sustainable practices that solve the problem of ethically controversial cobalt extraction. CoMET encourages the use of recycled cobalt, reducing the pressure to source new cobalt from unethical sources. The innovative approach of the CoMET project enables the production of cleaner, more efficient and more affordable cobalt-based materials. With the combination of cobalt and steel, they develop welding wire and hybrid tools with an extremely long service life, which helps to increase productivity, lower costs and sustainably transform the industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Metal Tech Solutions razvija inovativno rešitev, imenovano CoMET, za uporabo redkih elementov, kot je kobalt, v različnih panogah, zlasti v jeklarstvu. Pristop se osredotoča na trajnostno prakso, ki rešuje problem etično spornega pridobivanja kobalta. S CoMET-om spodbujajo uporabo recikliranega kobalta, kar zmanjšuje pritisk na pridobivanje novega kobalta iz neetičnih virov. Inovativni pristop projekta CoMET omogoča izdelavo bolj čistih, zmogljivejših in cenovno ugodnejših materialov na osnovi kobalta. S kombinacijo kobalta in jekla razvijajo varilno žico in hibridno orodje z izjemno dolgo življenjsko dobo, kar pripomore k dvigu produktivnosti, nižanju stroškov in trajnostni transformaciji industrije.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment and operation of the Slovenian Centre for Circular Economy - for green, creative and smart development
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vzpostavitev in delovanje Slovenskega centra za krožno gospodarstvo - za zeleni, ustvarjalni in pametni razvoj
Category_Label: Support to environmentally-friendly production processes and resource efficiency in SMEs
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the Slovenian Centre for Circular Economy is to promote sustainable development and efficient use of resources through the introduction of circular business models, the reduction of waste and the promotion of innovation in production and consumption. In doing so, we want to reduce our environmental footprint and create sustainable economic growth and social inclusion. The project includes the development of a holistic virtual platform with a wide range of services and tools for networking key actors from the research, business and civil sector, the implementation of educational programs, trainings and workshops, and consulting for all stakeholders, including small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), local communities and public administration, various publics. The CKG will also establish virtual and physical entry points throughout Slovenia, providing stakeholders with access to relevant information and services, as well as for the transition to a circular economy. CKG will be a partner for political decision-makers and the Ministry in promoting green transformation in Slovenia. The partnership brings together different economic sectors and involves key players from industry, academia and research institutions, enabling a systemic transformation of the economy towards a circular model. The project will contribute to greater competitiveness and sustainability of the Slovenian economy and support the goals of Slovenia's strategic documents in the field of green transition.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Slovenskega centra za krožno gospodarstvo je spodbujanje trajnostnega razvoja ter učinkovite rabe virov skozi uvajanje krožnih poslovnih modelov, zmanjšanje odpadkov in spodbujanje inovacij v proizvodnji in potrošnji. S tem želimo zmanjšati okoljski odtis ter ustvariti trajnostno gospodarsko rast in družbeno vključenost. Projekt vključuje razvoj holistične virtualne platforme s širokim naborom storitev in orodij na mreženje ključnih akterjev iz raziskovalne sfere, gospodarstva in civilnega sektorja, implementacijo izobraževalnih programov, usposabljanj in delavnic ter svetovanja za vse deležnike, vključno z malimi in srednje velikimi podjetji (MSP), lokalnimi skupnostmi in javno upravo, različnimi javnostmi. Prav tako bo CKG vzpostavil virtualne in fizične vstopne točke po celotni Sloveniji, ki bodo deležnikom zagotavljale dostop do relevantnih informacij in storitev kot tudi za prehod na krožno gospodarstvo. CKG bo partner političnem odločevalcem in ministrstvu pri pospeševanju zelene transformacije v Sloveniji.
