Operation_Name_English: Entrepreneurship over the challenges of the Carinthia region
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podjetno nad izzive Koroške regije
Category_Label: Incubation, support to spin offs and spin outs and start ups
Operation_Summary_English: Operation PONI Koroška is part of the comprehensive project PONI, which is carried out on the entire territory of Slovenia. The purpose of the operation PONI Koroška is the entrepreneurial training of persons who want to realize the entrepreneurial idea, thereby promoting entrepreneurship in the Koroška region. It is a 4-month entrepreneurial training programme for people who want to realize an entrepreneurial idea and turn it into commercially interesting products or services with the help of mentors and content trainings and counselling. The content of the training programme is structured in such a way that within 4 months of inclusion, participants receive key knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, which they need when entering an independent entrepreneurial path. The training program of the participant takes everything from the development of a business idea, to the creation of a business model and a business plan. At the same time, he is fully acquainted with all important areas in entrepreneurship. The project enables participants to use physical infrastructure (premises, equipment) according to the principle of co-working (joint division of office and equipment). By encouraging the formation of entrepreneurial teams, participants will also gain new knowledge, new acquaintances and business opportunities, as well as transfer experiences and examples of good practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Operacija PONI Koroška je del celovitega projekta PONI, ki se izvaja na območju celotne Slovenije. Namen operacije PONI Koroška je podjetniško usposabljanje oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo, s tem pa spodbujanje podjetništva v Koroški regiji. Gre za program 4 mesečnega podjetniškega usposabljanja oseb, ki želijo realizirati podjetniško idejo in jo ob pomoči mentorjev in vsebinskih usposabljanj ter svetovanj spremeniti v tržno zanimive produkte oziroma storitve. Program usposabljanja je vsebinsko sestavljen tako, da v 4 mesecih vključitve udeleženci prejmejo ključna znanja s področja podjetništva, ki jih ob vstopu na samostojno podjetniško pot potrebujejo. Program usposabljanja udeleženca pelje vse od razvoja poslovne ideje, do izdelave poslovnega modela in poslovnega načrta. Hkrati ga celostno seznani z vsemi pomembnimi področji v podjetništvu. Udeležencem projekt omogoča uporabo fizične infrastrukture (prostori, oprema) in sicer po principu co-workinga (skupne delitve pisarne in opreme). S spodbujanjem oblikovanja podjetniških ekip bodo udeleženci prišli tudi do novih znanj, novih poznanstev in poslovnih priložnosti ter prenašali izkušnje in primere dobrih praks.

Operation_Name_English: REDUCTION OF IRREGULAR PROTECTION OF APPLICATION – PHASE I
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZMANJŠANJE POPLAVNE OGROŽENOSTI POREČJA VIPAVE – I. FAZA
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: ‘Reducing the flood risk in the Vipava basin – Phase I; reduction of flood risk of Bela and Vrtojbice", is a reduction of flood risk of the area under consideration, especially in the area of significant impact of floods. The project includes part of the integrated measures to ensure flood safety in the Bela and Vrtojbica river basins, which have an impact on the floodplain. The project is aimed at reducing the flood risk of Bela and Vipava in the area of the municipalities of Vipava, Šempeter-Vrtojba and Miren-Renče. The implementation of integrated measures will reduce flood risk and risk along the treated sections. The measures are sized to ensure flood safety on Q100 flows.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: »Zmanjševanje poplavne ogroženosti porečja Vipave – I. faza; zmanjšanje poplavne ogroženosti Bele in Vrtojbice«, je zmanjšanje poplavne ogroženosti obravnavanega območja, predvsem na območju pomembnega vpliva poplav. Projekt vključuje del celovitih ukrepov za zagotavljanje poplavne varnosti v porečju reke Bele in Vrtojbice, ki vplivajo poplavno območje. Projekt je namenjen zmanjševanju poplavne ogroženosti Bele in Vipave na območju Občine Vipava, Šempeter-Vrtojba in Miren-Renče. Z izvedbo celostnih ukrepov se bo zmanjšala poplavna nevarnost in ogroženost vzdolž obravnavnih odsekov. Ukrepi so dimenzionirani za zagotavljanje poplavne varnosti na pretoke Q100.

Operation_Name_English: Modernisation of the social protection system and the protection of children and families with a view to ensuring greater efficiency, accessibility and quality of services for greater social inclusion of target groups
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Posodobitev sistema socialnega varstva ter varstva otrok in družin z namenom zagotavljanja večje učinkovitosti, dostopnosti in kvalitete storitev za večjo socialno vključenost ciljnih skupin
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the efficiency of the social protection system by strengthening staff and improving the quality of services, especially for the social inclusion of the most vulnerable people. The purpose of the project is also to strengthen the competences of professional staff at CSDs, specifically for working with families and vulnerable individuals, and thus strengthen social security services while strengthening protective factors and preventing potential risk factors. The introduction of methods with elements of fieldwork will allow to adapt to the needs of each individual case or user. With this approach, we will effectively contribute to overcoming social exclusion and increase the involvement of all stakeholders in providing assistance to the individual, while enhancing equal, timely access to quality, sustainable services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Namen projekta je izboljšati učinkovitost sistema socialnega varstva s krepitvijo kadra in izboljšanjem kakovosti storitev, še posebej za socialno vključevanje najbolj ranljivih ljudi. Namen projekta je tudi krepitev kompetenc strokovnega kadra na CSD-jih, specifično za delo z družinami in ranljivimi posamezniki in tako krepiti socialnovarstvene storitve pri tem pa okrepiti varovalne dejavnike ter preprečiti potencialne dejavnike tveganja. Uvajanje metod z elementi terenskega dela bo omogočalo prilagajanje potrebam vsakega posameznega primera oziroma uporabnika. S tem pristopom bomo učinkovito prispevali k preseganju socialne izključenosti in povečali vključenost vseh deležnikov pri nudenju pomoči posamezniku in pri tem okrepili enakopravni, pravočasni dostop do kakovostnih, trajnostnih storitev.
